## Insurance Companies Act {#insurance-companies-act .Title-of-Act}

[S.C.]{.abbr title="Statutes of Canada"} 1991, c. 47
:::

Assented to 1991-12-13

An Act respecting insurance companies and fraternal benefit societies
::::

::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::: section
::: Enacts
Her Majesty, by and with the advice and consent of the Senate and House
of Commons of Canada, enacts as follows:
:::

## [Short Title]{.HTitleText1} {#h-257664 .Part}

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Short title

**[[1]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-1 .sectionLabel}** This Act may be cited as
the [Insurance Companies Act](/eng/acts/I-11.8).

## [PART I]{.HLabel1}[Interpretation and Application]{.HTitleText1} {#h-257667 .Part}

### [Definitions]{.HTitleText2} {#h-257668 .Subheading}

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Definitions

- **[[2]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-2 .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} In this
  Act,

  [[actuary]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[actuary]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a Fellow of the Canadian
      Institute of Actuaries; ([actuaire]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[adjustable policy]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[adjustable policy]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means an adjustable
      policy as defined in the regulations; ([police
      ajustable]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[affairs]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[affairs]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}, with respect to a company, means
      the relationships among the company and its affiliates and the
      shareholders, policyholders, directors and officers of the company
      and its affiliates, but does not include the business of the
      company or any of its affiliates; ([affaires
      internes]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[affiliate]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[affiliate]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means an entity that is
      affiliated with another entity within the meaning of section
      6; ([groupe]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[Agency]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[Agency]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means the Financial Consumer Agency
      of Canada established under section 3 of the [Financial Consumer
      Agency of Canada
      Act](/eng/acts/F-11.1); ([Agence]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[annual return]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[annual return]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a return prepared in
      accordance with subsection 665(1) or (2); ([état
      annuel]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[annual statement]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[annual statement]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}, in relation to a
      company, means the annual financial statement of the company
      within the meaning of paragraph 331(1)(a) and, in relation to an
      insurance holding company, means the annual financial statement of
      the insurance holding company within the meaning of paragraph
      887(1)(a); ([rapport annuel]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[assets in Canada]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[assets in Canada]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means the assets that
      have been vested in trust for a foreign company under Part
      XIII; ([actif au Canada]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[auditor]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[auditor]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} includes a firm of
      accountants; ([vérificateur]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[bank holding company]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[bank holding company]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a body
      corporate that is incorporated or formed under Part XV of the
      [Bank Act](/eng/acts/B-1.01); ([société de portefeuille
      bancaire]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[bearer]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[bearer]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}, in relation to a security, means
      the person in possession of a security payable to bearer or
      endorsed in blank; ([porteur]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[bearer form]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[bearer form]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}, in respect of a security,
      means a security in bearer form as determined in accordance with
      subsection 87(2); ([titre au porteur]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[beneficial ownership]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[beneficial ownership]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} includes ownership
      through one or more trustees, legal representatives, agents or
      other intermediaries; ([véritable propriétaire]{.DefinedTermLink
      lang="fr"} et [propriété effective]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[body corporate]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[body corporate]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means an incorporated body
      wherever or however incorporated; ([personne
      morale]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[Canadian financial institution]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[Canadian financial institution]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a
      financial institution that is incorporated or formed by or under
      an Act of Parliament or of the legislature of a
      province; ([institution financière canadienne]{.DefinedTermLink
      lang="fr"})

  [[central securities register]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[central securities register]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} or
      [[securities register]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}, in relation to a
      company or an insurance holding company, means the register
      referred to in section 271; ([registre central des valeurs
      mobilières]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"} ou [registre des valeurs
      mobilières]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[class]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[class]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}, in respect of insurance or an
      insurance policy, means a class determined in accordance with
      section 12; ([branche]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[Commissioner]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[Commissioner]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means the Commissioner of the
      Financial Consumer Agency of Canada appointed under section 4 of
      the [Financial Consumer Agency of Canada
      Act](/eng/acts/F-11.1); ([commissaire]{.DefinedTermLink
      lang="fr"})

  [[common-law partner]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[common-law partner]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}, in relation to an
      individual, means a person who is cohabiting with the individual
      in a conjugal relationship, having so cohabited for a period of at
      least one year; ([conjoint de fait]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[company]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[company]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a body corporate referred to
      in subsection 13(1); ([société]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[complainant]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[complainant]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}, in relation to a company or
      any matter concerning a company, means

      - [(a)]{.lawlabel} a registered holder or beneficial owner, and a
        former registered holder or beneficial owner, of a security of
        the company or any of its affiliates,

      - [(a.1)]{.lawlabel} a policyholder entitled to vote at a meeting
        of policyholders or shareholders and policyholders of the
        company,

      - [(b)]{.lawlabel} a director or an officer, or a former director
        or officer, of the company or any of its affiliates, or

      - [(c)]{.lawlabel} any other person who, in the discretion of a
        court, is a proper person to make an application under section
        371, 375 or 1031; ([plaignant]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[consumer provision]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[consumer provision]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a provision
      referred to in paragraph (c) or (c.1) of the definition [[consumer
      provision]{.dfn}]{.DefinitionRef} in section 2 of the [Financial
      Consumer Agency of Canada Act](/eng/acts/F-11.1); ([disposition
      visant les consommateurs]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[converted company]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[converted company]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a mutual company
      that has been converted under this Act into a company with common
      shares; ([société transformée]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[court]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[court]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means

      - [(a)]{.lawlabel} in the Province of Ontario, the Superior Court
        of Justice,

      - [(b)]{.lawlabel} in the Province of Quebec, the Superior Court
        of the Province,

      - [(c)]{.lawlabel} in the Provinces of Nova Scotia, British
        Columbia and Prince Edward Island, the Supreme Court of the
        Province,

      - [(d)]{.lawlabel} in the Provinces of New Brunswick, Manitoba,
        Saskatchewan and Alberta, the Court of Queen's Bench for the
        Province,

      - [(e)]{.lawlabel} in the Province of Newfoundland and Labrador,
        the Trial Division of the Supreme Court of the Province, and

      - [(f)]{.lawlabel} in Yukon and the Northwest Territories, the
        Supreme Court, and in Nunavut, the Nunavut Court of
        Justice; ([tribunal]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[court of appeal]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[court of appeal]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means the court to which
      an appeal lies from a decision or order of a court; ([cour
      d'appel]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[debt obligation]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[debt obligation]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a bond, debenture,
      note or other evidence of indebtedness of an entity, whether
      secured or unsecured; ([titre de créance]{.DefinedTermLink
      lang="fr"})

  [[director]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[director]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a natural person occupying
      the position of director, by whatever name called, of a body
      corporate, and [[board of directors]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} or
      [[directors]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} refers to the directors of a
      body corporate as a body and, in the case of a society, refers to
      the supreme governing body of the
      society; ([administrateur]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"}, [conseil
      d'administration]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"} ou
      [conseil]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[equity]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[equity]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}, in respect of a company or an
      insurance holding company, means its equity as determined in
      accordance with the regulations; ([capitaux
      propres]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[entity]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[entity]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a body corporate, trust,
      partnership, fund, an unincorporated association or organization,
      Her Majesty in right of Canada or of a province, an agency of Her
      Majesty in either of such rights and the government of a foreign
      country or any political subdivision thereof and any agency
      thereof; ([entité]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[federal credit union]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[federal credit union]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} has the same meaning
      as in section 2 of the [Bank Act](/eng/acts/B-1.01); ([coopérative
      de crédit fédérale]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[federal financial institution]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[federal financial institution]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means

      - [(a)]{.lawlabel} a company or a society,

      - [(b)]{.lawlabel} a bank,

      - [(c)]{.lawlabel} a body corporate to which the [Trust and Loan
        Companies Act](/eng/acts/T-19.8) applies, or

      - [(d)]{.lawlabel} an association to which the [Cooperative Credit
        Associations Act](/eng/acts/C-41.01) applies; ([institution
        financière fédérale]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[fiduciary]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[fiduciary]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means any person acting in a
      fiduciary capacity and includes a personal representative of a
      deceased person; ([représentant]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[financial institution]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[financial institution]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means

      - [(a)]{.lawlabel} a company or a society,

      - [(b)]{.lawlabel} a bank or an authorized foreign bank within the
        meaning of section 2 of the [Bank Act](/eng/acts/B-1.01),

      - [(c)]{.lawlabel} a body corporate to which the [Trust and Loan
        Companies Act](/eng/acts/T-19.8) applies,

      - [(d)]{.lawlabel} an association to which the [Cooperative Credit
        Associations Act](/eng/acts/C-41.01) applies,

      - [(e)]{.lawlabel} a trust, loan or insurance corporation
        incorporated by or under an Act of the legislature of a
        province,

      - [(f)]{.lawlabel} a cooperative credit society incorporated and
        regulated by or under an Act of the legislature of a province,

      - [(g)]{.lawlabel} an entity that is incorporated or formed by or
        under an Act of Parliament or of the legislature of a province
        and that is primarily engaged in dealing in securities,
        including portfolio management and investment counselling, and

      - [(h)]{.lawlabel} a foreign institution; ([institution
        financière]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[financial year]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[financial year]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}, in respect of a foreign
      company, means a calendar year; ([exercice]{.DefinedTermLink
      lang="fr"})

  [[foreign company]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[foreign company]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means an entity that is
      the subject of an order made under subsection 574(1); ([société
      étrangère]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[foreign institution]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[foreign institution]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means an entity that
      is

      - [(a)]{.lawlabel} engaged in the business of banking, the trust,
        loan or insurance business, the business of a cooperative credit
        society or the business of dealing in securities or is otherwise
        engaged primarily in the business of providing financial
        services, and

      - [(b)]{.lawlabel} incorporated or formed otherwise than by or
        under an Act of Parliament or of the legislature of a
        province; ([institution étrangère]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[former-Act company]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[former-Act company]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a body corporate
      referred to in paragraph 13(1)(b); ([société
      antérieure]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[former-Act society]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[former-Act society]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a body corporate
      referred to in paragraph 13(2)(b); ([société de secours
      antérieure]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[form of proxy]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[form of proxy]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a written or printed
      form that, when completed and executed by or on behalf of a
      shareholder or a policyholder, or, in the case of a fraternal
      benefit society, a member, constitutes a proxy; ([formulaire de
      procuration]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[fraternal benefit society]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[fraternal benefit society]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a body
      corporate

      - [(a)]{.lawlabel} that is without share capital,

      - [(b)]{.lawlabel} that has a representative form of government,
        and

      - [(c)]{.lawlabel} that was incorporated for fraternal, benevolent
        or religious purposes, including the provision of insurance
        benefits solely to its members or the spouses, common-law
        partners or children of its members; ([société de secours
        mutuel]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[going-private transaction]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[going-private transaction]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a
      going-private transaction as defined in the
      regulations; ([transaction de fermeture]{.DefinedTermLink
      lang="fr"})

  [[guarantee]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[guarantee]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} includes a letter of
      credit; ([garantie]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[head office]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[head office]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means

      - [(a)]{.lawlabel} in relation to a company, the office required
        to be maintained by the company under section 260,

      - [(b)]{.lawlabel} in relation to a society, the office required
        to be maintained by the society under section 544, and

      - [(c)]{.lawlabel} in relation to an insurance holding company,
        the office required to be maintained by the insurance holding
        company under section 868; ([siège]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[holder]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[holder]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means

      - [(a)]{.lawlabel} in respect of a security certificate, the
        person in possession of the certificate issued or endorsed to
        that person or to bearer or in blank, and

      - [(b)]{.lawlabel} in respect of the ownership of a share, the
        shareholder of the share within the meaning of section
        7; ([détenteur]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[holding body corporate]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[holding body corporate]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a holding
      body corporate within the meaning of section 4; ([société
      mère]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[incorporated]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[incorporated]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}, when used with reference to
      a body corporate that is incorporated by or under an Act of
      Parliament or of the legislature of a province, also refers to a
      body corporate that is continued by or under any such
      Act; ([constitué en personne morale]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[incorporating instrument]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[incorporating instrument]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means the special
      Act, letters patent, instrument of continuance or other constating
      instrument by which a body corporate was incorporated or continued
      and includes any amendment to or restatement of the constating
      instrument; ([acte constitutif]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[incorporator]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[incorporator]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}, in relation to a company or
      an insurance holding company, means a person who applied for
      letters patent to incorporate the company or insurance holding
      company, as the case may be; ([fondateur]{.DefinedTermLink
      lang="fr"})

  [[infrastructure asset]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[infrastructure asset]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a physical
      asset, including a long-lived physical asset that supports the
      delivery of public services, prescribed by
      regulation; ([infrastructure]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[insurance holding company]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[insurance holding company]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a body
      corporate that is incorporated or formed under Part
      XVII; ([société de portefeuille d'assurances]{.DefinedTermLink
      lang="fr"})

  [[issuer]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[issuer]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}, in respect of a security, means
      the entity that issues or issued the
      security; ([émetteur]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[letters patent]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[letters patent]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}, in respect of an
      instrument authorized to be issued under this Act, means letters
      patent in a form approved by the Superintendent; ([lettres
      patentes]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[life company]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[life company]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a company or a
      provincial company that is permitted to insure risks falling
      within the class of life insurance, other than a company or a
      provincial company that is also permitted to insure risks falling
      within any other class of insurance other than accident and
      sickness insurance, credit protection insurance and other approved
      products insurance; ([société d'assurance-vie]{.DefinedTermLink
      lang="fr"})

  [[marine company]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[marine company]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a company that is
      incorporated for the sole purpose of insuring risks within the
      class of marine insurance; ([société d'assurance
      maritime]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[Minister]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[Minister]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means the Minister of
      Finance; ([ministre]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[minor]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[minor]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} has the same meaning as in the
      applicable provincial law and in the absence of any such law has
      the same meaning as the word "child" in the United Nations
      Convention on the Rights of the Child adopted in the United
      Nations General Assembly on November 20,
      1989; ([mineur]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[mutual company]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[mutual company]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means

      - [(a)]{.lawlabel} a company that is incorporated or continued as
        a mutual company under this Act,

      - [(b)]{.lawlabel} a former-Act company that, on the coming into
        force of this paragraph, has no issued and outstanding shares,
        or

      - [(c)]{.lawlabel} a company that is converted into a mutual
        company under sections 226 to 236,

      and that is not converted into a company with common shares under
      this Act; ([société mutuelle]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[non-WTO Member foreign institution]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[non-WTO Member foreign institution]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a
      foreign institution that is not controlled by a WTO Member
      resident; ([institution étrangère d'un non-membre de
      l'OMC]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[officer]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[officer]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means

      - [(a)]{.lawlabel} in relation to a body corporate, a chief
        executive officer, president, vice-president, secretary,
        controller, treasurer and any other natural person designated as
        an officer of the body corporate by by-law or by resolution of
        the directors of the body corporate, and

      - [(b)]{.lawlabel} in relation to any other entity, any natural
        person designated as an officer of the entity by by-law, by
        resolution of the members thereof or
        otherwise; ([dirigeant]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[order form]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[order form]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}, in respect of a security,
      means a security in order form as determined in accordance with
      subsection 87(3); ([titre à ordre]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[ordinary resolution]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[ordinary resolution]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a resolution
      passed by a majority of the votes cast by or on behalf of the
      shareholders or policyholders who voted in respect of that
      resolution; ([résolution ordinaire]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[participating policy]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[participating policy]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a policy issued
      by a company that entitles its holder to participate in the
      profits of the company; ([police à participation]{.DefinedTermLink
      lang="fr"})

  [[participating policyholder]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[participating policyholder]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means the
      holder of a participating policy; ([souscripteur avec
      participation]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[permitted infrastructure entity]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[permitted infrastructure entity]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means an
      entity that, in accordance with prescribed conditions, only makes
      investments in infrastructure assets or engages in any other
      activity prescribed by regulation; ([entité d'infrastructure
      admissible]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[person]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[person]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a natural person, an entity
      or a personal representative; ([personne]{.DefinedTermLink
      lang="fr"})

  [[personal representative]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[personal representative]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a person who
      stands in place of and represents another person and, without
      limiting the generality of the foregoing, includes, as the
      circumstances require, a trustee, an executor, an administrator, a
      committee, a guardian, a tutor, a curator, an assignee, a
      receiver, an agent or an attorney of any person; ([représentant
      personnel]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[policy]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[policy]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means any written contract of
      insurance or reinsurance whether contained in one or more
      documents and, in the case of insurance in a fraternal benefit
      society, any contract of insurance whether evidenced by a written
      document or not and any certificate of membership relating in any
      way to insurance, and includes any annuity contract and any
      endowment insurance contract; ([police]{.DefinedTermLink
      lang="fr"})

  [[policy in Canada]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[policy in Canada]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}[\[Repealed, 2007, c.
      6, s. 186\]]{.Repealed}

  [[policyholder in Canada]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[policyholder in Canada]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}[\[Repealed,
      2007, c. 6, s. 186\]]{.Repealed}

  [[prescribed]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[prescribed]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means prescribed by
      regulation; ([Version anglaise seulement]{.DefinedTermLink
      lang="fr"})

  [[property and casualty company]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[property and casualty company]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a
      company or a provincial company that is not a life company or a
      marine company; ([société d'assurances
      multirisques]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[provincial company]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[provincial company]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means, subject to
      subsection (1.1),

      - [(a)]{.lawlabel} [\[Repealed, 2001, c. 9, s. 345\]]{.Repealed}

      - [(b)]{.lawlabel} Antigonish Farmers' Mutual Fire Insurance
        Company,

      - [(c)]{.lawlabel} Clare Mutual Insurance Company,

      - [(d)]{.lawlabel} The Halifax Insurance Company, or

      - [(e)]{.lawlabel} Pictou County Farmers' Mutual Fire Insurance
        Company,

      or, if the name of such company is changed, includes the successor
      company by its new name; ([société provinciale]{.DefinedTermLink
      lang="fr"})

  [[proxy]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[proxy]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a completed and executed form
      of proxy by means of which a shareholder or policyholder or, in
      the case of a society, a member, appoints a proxyholder to attend
      and act on behalf of the shareholder, policyholder or member at a
      meeting of shareholders, policyholders or
      members; ([procuration]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[proxyholder]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[proxyholder]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means the person appointed by
      proxy to attend and act on behalf of a shareholder or a
      policyholder or, in the case of a society, a member at a meeting
      of shareholders, policyholders or members; ([fondé de
      pouvoir]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[real property]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[real property]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} includes a leasehold
      interest in real property; ([biens immeubles]{.DefinedTermLink
      lang="fr"})

  [[recorded address]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[recorded address]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means

      - [(a)]{.lawlabel} in relation to a person who is a shareholder of
        a company or an insurance holding company, the latest postal
        address of the person according to the central securities
        register of the company or the insurance holding company, as the
        case may be, and

      - [(b)]{.lawlabel} in relation to a person in any other respect,
        the latest postal address of the person according to the records
        of the company or insurance holding company; ([adresse
        enregistrée]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[registered form]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[registered form]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}, in respect of a security,
      means a security in registered form as determined in accordance
      with subsection 87(4); ([titre nominatif]{.DefinedTermLink
      lang="fr"})

  [[regulated foreign entity]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[regulated foreign entity]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means an entity
      that is

      - [(a)]{.lawlabel} incorporated or formed otherwise in a country
        or territory, other than Canada, in which a trade agreement
        listed in Schedule IV of the [Bank Act](/eng/acts/B-1.01) is
        applicable; and

      - [(b)]{.lawlabel} subject to financial services regulation in
        that country or territory; ([entité étrangère
        réglementée]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[regulatory capital]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[regulatory capital]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}, in respect of a
      company, a society, a provincial company or an insurance holding
      company, has the meaning given that expression by the
      regulations; ([capital réglementaire]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[resident Canadian]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[resident Canadian]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a natural person
      who is

      - [(a)]{.lawlabel} a Canadian citizen ordinarily resident in
        Canada,

      - [(b)]{.lawlabel} a Canadian citizen not ordinarily resident in
        Canada who is a member of a prescribed class of persons, or

      - [(c)]{.lawlabel} a permanent resident within the meaning of
        subsection 2(1) of the [Immigration and Refugee Protection
        Act](/eng/acts/I-2.5) and ordinarily resident in Canada, except
        a permanent resident who has been ordinarily resident in Canada
        for more than one year after the time at which the individual
        first became eligible to apply for Canadian
        citizenship; ([résident canadien]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[residential property]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[residential property]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means real property
      consisting of buildings that are used, or are to be used, to the
      extent of at least one half of the floor space thereof, as one or
      more private dwellings; ([immeuble résidentiel]{.DefinedTermLink
      lang="fr"})

  [[securities underwriter]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[securities underwriter]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a person who,
      as principal, agrees to purchase securities with a view to the
      distribution of the securities or who, as agent for a body
      corporate or other person, offers for sale or sells securities in
      connection with a distribution of the securities, and includes a
      person who participates, directly or indirectly, in a distribution
      of securities, other than a person whose interest in the
      distribution of securities is limited to receiving a distributor's
      or seller's commission payable by a securities
      underwriter; ([souscripteur à forfait]{.DefinedTermLink
      lang="fr"})

  [[security]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[security]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means

      - [(a)]{.lawlabel} in relation to a body corporate, a share of any
        class of shares of the body corporate or a debt obligation of
        the body corporate, and includes a warrant of the body
        corporate, but does not include a deposit with a financial
        institution or any instrument evidencing such a deposit, and

      - [(b)]{.lawlabel} in relation to any other entity, any ownership
        interest in or debt obligation of the entity,

      but does not include a policy; ([titre]{.DefinedTermLink
      lang="fr"} ou [valeur mobilière]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[security interest]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[security interest]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means an interest in or
      charge on property by way of mortgage, lien, pledge or otherwise
      taken by a creditor or guarantor to secure the payment or
      performance of an obligation; ([sûreté]{.DefinedTermLink
      lang="fr"})

  [[send]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[send]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} includes
      deliver; ([envoyer]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[series]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[series]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}, in respect of shares, means a
      division of a class of shares; ([série]{.DefinedTermLink
      lang="fr"})

  [[significant interest]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[significant interest]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a significant
      interest determined in accordance with section 8; ([intérêt
      substantiel]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[society]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[society]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a body corporate referred to
      in subsection 13(2) that is a fraternal benefit society; ([société
      de secours]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[special resolution]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[special resolution]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a resolution
      passed by a majority of not less than two thirds of the votes cast
      by or on behalf of the shareholders and policyholders and, in the
      case of a fraternal benefit society, the members, who voted in
      respect of that resolution or signed by all the shareholders,
      policyholders and members entitled to vote on that
      resolution; ([résolution extraordinaire]{.DefinedTermLink
      lang="fr"})

  [[squeeze-out transaction]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[squeeze-out transaction]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a
      transaction by a company that is not a distributing company, or an
      insurance holding company that is not a distributing insurance
      holding company, that requires an amendment to a by-law referred
      to in subsection 238(1) or 851(1), as the case may be, and that
      would directly or indirectly result in the interest of a holder of
      shares of a class of shares being terminated without their consent
      and without substituting an interest of equivalent value in shares
      that are issued by the following persons and have rights and
      privileges equal to or greater than those of the shares of the
      affected class:

      - [(a)]{.lawlabel} in the case of a company, the company, and

      - [(b)]{.lawlabel} in the case of an insurance holding company,
        the insurance holding company; ([transaction
        d'éviction]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[subordinated indebtedness]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[subordinated indebtedness]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means an
      instrument evidencing an indebtedness of a company that by its
      terms provides that the indebtedness will, in the event of the
      insolvency or winding-up of the company, be subordinate in right
      of payment to all policy liabilities of the company and all other
      liabilities of the company except those other liabilities that, by
      their terms, rank equally with or are subordinate to such
      indebtedness; ([titre secondaire]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[subsidiary]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[subsidiary]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means an entity that is a
      subsidiary of another entity within the meaning of section
      5; ([filiale]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[substantial investment]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[substantial investment]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a substantial
      investment determined in accordance with section 10; ([intérêt de
      groupe financier]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[Superintendent]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[Superintendent]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means the Superintendent of
      Financial Institutions appointed pursuant to the [Office of the
      Superintendent of Financial Institutions
      Act](/eng/acts/O-2.7); ([surintendant]{.DefinedTermLink
      lang="fr"})

  [[total assets]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[total assets]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}, in respect of a company,
      society, provincial company or insurance holding company, has the
      meaning given that expression by the regulations; ([actif
      total]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[trade]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[trade]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}, in respect of securities, means any
      sale or disposition of securities for valuable
      consideration; ([opération]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[transfer]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[transfer]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}, in respect of securities,
      includes a transmission by operation of
      law; ([transfert]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

  [[voting share]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[voting share]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a share of any class of
      shares of a body corporate carrying voting rights under all
      circumstances or by reason of an event that has occurred and is
      continuing or by reason of a condition that has been
      fulfilled; ([action avec droit de vote]{.DefinedTermLink
      lang="fr"})

  [[WTO Member resident]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  :   [[WTO Member resident]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a WTO Member
      resident within the meaning of section 11.1. ([résident d'un
      membre de l'OMC]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Provincial company status

  [(1.1)]{.lawlabel} A company referred to in the definition
  [[provincial company]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} in subsection (1) ceases to
  be a provincial company for the purposes of this Act if the order made
  by the Superintendent under subsection 657(1) approving the
  commencement and carrying on of business by the company is revoked.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Policy loans

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} For greater certainty, any reference in this Act to a
  loan does not include, unless otherwise provided, a reference to an
  advance on the security or against the cash surrender value of a
  policy.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Major shareholder

  [(3)]{.lawlabel} For the purposes of this Act, a person is a major
  shareholder of a body corporate if

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the aggregate of the shares of any class of voting
    shares of the body corporate that are beneficially owned by the
    person and that are beneficially owned by any entities controlled by
    the person is more than 20 per cent of the outstanding shares of
    that class of voting shares of the body corporate; or

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} the aggregate of the shares of any class of
    non-voting shares of the body corporate that are beneficially owned
    by the person and that are beneficially owned by any entities
    controlled by the person is more than 30 per cent of the outstanding
    shares of that class of non-voting shares of the body corporate.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Widely held

  [(4)]{.lawlabel} For the purposes of this Act, a body corporate is
  widely held if it has no major shareholder.

### [Interpretation]{.HTitleText2} {#h-257834 .Subheading}

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Regulations --- distributing company or
insurance holding company

- **[[2.1]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-2.1 .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} The
  Governor in Council may make regulations respecting the determination
  of what constitutes a distributing company or distributing insurance
  holding company for the purposes of this Act.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Exemption --- company or insurance
  holding company

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} On the application of a company or insurance holding
  company, the Superintendent may determine that it is not or was not a
  distributing company or distributing insurance holding company, as the
  case may be, if the Superintendent is satisfied that the determination
  would not prejudice any security holder of that company or insurance
  holding company.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Exemption --- class of companies or
  insurance holding companies

  [(3)]{.lawlabel} The Superintendent may determine that members of a
  class of companies or insurance holding companies are not or were not
  distributing companies or distributing insurance holding companies, as
  the case may be, if the Superintendent is satisfied that the
  determination would not prejudice any security holder of a member of
  the class.

::: HistoricalNote
- 2005, c. 54, s. 215
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Regulations --- permitted infrastructure
entities

**[[2.2]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-2.2 .sectionLabel}** The Governor in Council
may make regulations prescribing

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} physical assets for the purposes of the definition
  [[infrastructure asset]{.dfn}]{.DefinitionRef};

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} activities in which a permitted infrastructure entity
  is permitted to engage; and

- [(c)]{.lawlabel} conditions applicable to investments made and other
  activities carried out by permitted infrastructure entities.

::: HistoricalNote
- [2018, c. 12, s. 343](#1038658-1423829){.wb-lbx
  aria-controls="centred-popup" ajax-after="1038658-1423829.html"
  role="button"}
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Control

- **[[3]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-3 .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} For the
  purposes of this Act,

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} a person controls a body corporate if securities of
    the body corporate to which are attached more than 50 per cent of
    the votes that may be cast to elect directors of the body corporate
    are beneficially owned by the person and the votes attached to those
    securities are sufficient, if exercised, to elect a majority of the
    directors of the body corporate;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} a person controls an unincorporated entity, other
    than a limited partnership, if more than 50 per cent of the
    ownership interests, however designated, into which the entity is
    divided are beneficially owned by that person and the person is able
    to direct the business and affairs of the entity;

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} the general partner of a limited partnership
    controls the limited partnership; and

  - [(d)]{.lawlabel} a person controls an entity if the person has any
    direct or indirect influence that, if exercised, would result in
    control in fact of the entity.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Deemed control

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} A person who controls an entity is deemed to control
  any entity that is controlled, or deemed to be controlled, by the
  entity.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Deemed control

  [(3)]{.lawlabel} A person is deemed to control, within the meaning of
  paragraph (1)(a) or (b), an entity if the aggregate of

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} any securities of the entity that are beneficially
    owned by that person, and

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} any securities of the entity that are beneficially
    owned by any entity controlled by that person

  is such that, if that person and all of the entities referred to in
  paragraph (b) that beneficially own securities of the entity were one
  person, that person would control the entity.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Guidelines

  [(4)]{.lawlabel} The Minister may, for any purpose of any provision of
  this Act that refers to control within the meaning of paragraph
  (1)(d), make guidelines respecting what constitutes such control,
  including guidelines describing the policy objectives that the
  guidelines and the relevant provisions of the Act are intended to
  achieve and, if any such guidelines are made, the reference to
  paragraph (1)(d) in that provision shall be interpreted in accordance
  with the guidelines.

::: HistoricalNote
- 1991, c. 47, s. 3
- 2001, c. 9, s. 346
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Holding body corporate

**[[4]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-4 .sectionLabel}** A body corporate is the
holding body corporate of any entity that is its subsidiary.

::: HistoricalNote
- 1991, c. 47, s. 4
- 2001, c. 9, s. 347
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Subsidiary

**[[5]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-5 .sectionLabel}** An entity is a subsidiary
of another entity if it is controlled by the other entity.

::: HistoricalNote
- 1991, c. 47, s. 5
- 2001, c. 9, s. 347
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Affiliated entities

- **[[6]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-6 .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} One
  entity is affiliated with another entity if one of them is controlled
  by the other or both are controlled by the same person.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Affiliated entities

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} Despite subsection (1), for the purposes of Divisions
  VIII and X of Part VI and Subdivisions 8 and 10 of Division 6 of Part
  XVII, one entity is affiliated with another entity if one of them is
  controlled, determined without regard to paragraph 3(1)(d), by the
  other or both are controlled, determined without regard to paragraph
  3(1)(d), by the same person.

::: HistoricalNote
- 1991, c. 47, s. 6
- 2001, c. 9, s. 348
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Shareholder

- **[[7]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-7 .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} For the
  purposes of this Act, a person is a shareholder of a body corporate
  when, according to the securities register of the body corporate, the
  person is the owner of one or more shares of the body corporate or is
  entitled to be entered in the securities register or like record of
  the body corporate as the owner of the share or shares.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Holder of a share

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} A reference in this Act to the holding of a share by
  or in the name of any person is a reference to the fact that the
  person is registered or is entitled to be registered in the securities
  register or like record of the body corporate as the holder of that
  share.

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Significant interest

- **[[8]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-8 .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} A person
  has a significant interest in a class of shares of a company or an
  insurance holding company if the aggregate of

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} any shares of that class beneficially owned by the
    person, and

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} any shares of that class beneficially owned by
    entities controlled by the person

  exceeds 10 per cent of all of the outstanding shares of that class of
  shares of the company or insurance holding company, as the case may
  be.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Increasing significant interest

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} A person who has a significant interest in a class of
  shares of a company or insurance holding company increases that
  significant interest in the class of shares if the person or any
  entity controlled by the person

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} acquires beneficial ownership of additional shares
    of that class, or

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} acquires control of any entity that beneficially
    owns shares of that class,

  in such number as to increase the percentage of shares of that class
  that are beneficially owned by the person and by any entities
  controlled by the person.

::: HistoricalNote
- 1991, c. 47, s. 8
- 2001, c. 9, s. 349
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Acting in concert

- **[[9]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-9 .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} For the
  purposes of Part VII and Division 7 of Part XVII, if two or more
  persons have agreed, under any agreement, commitment or understanding,
  whether formal or informal, verbal or written, to act jointly or in
  concert in respect of

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} shares of a company or of an insurance holding
    company that they beneficially own,

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} shares or ownership interests that they
    beneficially own of any entity that beneficially owns shares of a
    company or of an insurance holding company, or

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} shares or ownership interests that they
    beneficially own of any entity that controls any entity that
    beneficially owns shares of a company or insurance holding company,

  those persons are deemed to be a single person who is acquiring
  beneficial ownership of the aggregate number of shares of the company
  or insurance holding company or shares or ownership interests of the
  entity that are beneficially owned by them.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Acting in concert

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} Without limiting the generality of subsection (1),
  any agreement, commitment or understanding by or between two or more
  persons who beneficially own shares of a company or insurance holding
  company or shares or ownership interests of any entity referred to in
  paragraph (1)(b) or (c),

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} whereby any of them or their nominees may veto any
    proposal put before the board of directors of the company or
    insurance holding company, as the case may be, or

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} under which no proposal put before the board of
    directors of the company or insurance holding company, as the case
    may be, may be approved except with the consent of any of them or
    their nominees,

  is deemed to be an agreement, commitment or understanding referred to
  in subsection (1).

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Exceptions

  [(3)]{.lawlabel} For the purposes of this section, persons shall be
  presumed not to have agreed to act jointly or in concert solely by
  reason of the fact that

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} one is the proxyholder of one or more of the others
    in respect of shares or ownership interests referred to in
    subsection (1); or

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} they vote the voting rights attached to shares or
    ownership interests referred to in subsection (1) in the same
    manner.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Designation

  [(4)]{.lawlabel} Where in the opinion of the Superintendent it is
  reasonable to conclude that an agreement, commitment or understanding
  referred to in subsections (1) and (2) exists by or among two or more
  persons, the Superintendent may designate those persons as persons who
  have agreed to act jointly or in concert.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Contravention

  [(5)]{.lawlabel} A person contravenes a provision of Part VII or
  Division 7 of Part XVII if the person agrees to act jointly or in
  concert with one or more other persons in such a manner that a deemed
  single person contravenes the provision.

::: HistoricalNote
- 1991, c. 47, s. 9
- 2001, c. 9, s. 350
- 2007, c. 6, s. 187
:::

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-9-20030101.html "Link to previous version of section 9"){.PITLink}
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Substantial investment in body corporate

- **[[10]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-10 .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} A
  person has a substantial investment in a body corporate where

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the voting rights attached to the aggregate of any
    voting shares of the body corporate beneficially owned by the person
    and by any entities controlled by the person exceed 10 per cent of
    the voting rights attached to all of the outstanding voting shares
    of the body corporate; or

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} the aggregate of any shares of the body corporate
    beneficially owned by the person and by any entities controlled by
    the person represents ownership of greater than 25 per cent of the
    shareholders' equity of the body corporate.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Increasing substantial investment in
  body corporate

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} A person who has a substantial investment in a body
  corporate pursuant to paragraph (1)(a) increases that substantial
  investment when the person or any entity controlled by the person

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} acquires beneficial ownership of additional voting
    shares of the body corporate in such number as to increase the
    percentage of voting rights attached to the aggregate of the voting
    shares of the body corporate beneficially owned by the person and by
    any entities controlled by the person; or

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} acquires control of any entity that beneficially
    owns any voting shares of the body corporate in such number as to
    increase the percentage of voting rights attached to the aggregate
    of the voting shares of the body corporate beneficially owned by the
    person and by any entities controlled by the person.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Idem

  [(3)]{.lawlabel} A person who has a substantial investment in a body
  corporate pursuant to paragraph (1)(b) increases that substantial
  investment when the person or any entity controlled by the person

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} acquires beneficial ownership of additional shares
    of the body corporate in such number as to increase the percentage
    of the shareholders' equity of the body corporate represented by the
    aggregate of the shares of the body corporate beneficially owned by
    the person and by any entities controlled by the person; or

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} acquires control of any entity that beneficially
    owns any shares of the body corporate in such number as to increase
    the percentage of the shareholders' equity of the body corporate
    represented by the aggregate of the shares of the body corporate
    beneficially owned by the person and by any entities controlled by
    the person.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}New substantial investment

  [(4)]{.lawlabel} For greater certainty,

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} where a person has a substantial investment in a
    body corporate pursuant to paragraph (1)(a) and the person, or any
    entity controlled by the person,

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} purchases or otherwise acquires beneficial
      ownership of shares of the body corporate, or

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} acquires control of any entity that beneficially
      owns shares of the body corporate,

    in such number as to cause the shareholders' equity of the body
    corporate represented by the aggregate of the shares of the body
    corporate beneficially owned by the person and by any entities
    controlled by the person to exceed 25 per cent of the shareholders'
    equity of the body corporate, or

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} where a person has a substantial investment in a
    body corporate pursuant to paragraph (1)(b) and the person or any
    entity controlled by the person

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} purchases or otherwise acquires beneficial
      ownership of voting shares of the body corporate, or

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} acquires control of any entity that beneficially
      owns voting shares of the body corporate,

    in such number as to cause the voting rights attached to the
    aggregate of the voting shares beneficially owned by the person and
    by any entities controlled by the person to exceed 10 per cent of
    the voting rights attached to all of the outstanding voting shares
    of the company,

  the acquisition is deemed to cause the person to increase a
  substantial investment in the body corporate.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Substantial investment in
  unincorporated entity

  [(5)]{.lawlabel} A person has a substantial investment in an
  unincorporated entity where the aggregate of any ownership interests,
  however designated, into which the entity is divided, beneficially
  owned by the person and by any entities controlled by the person
  exceeds 25 per cent of all of the ownership interests into which the
  entity is divided.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Increasing substantial investment in
  unincorporated entities

  [(6)]{.lawlabel} A person who has a substantial investment in an
  unincorporated entity increases that substantial investment when the
  person or any entity controlled by the person

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} acquires beneficial ownership of additional
    ownership interests in the unincorporated entity in such number as
    to increase the percentage of ownership interests in the
    unincorporated entity beneficially owned by the person and by any
    entities controlled by the person; or

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} acquires control of any entity that beneficially
    owns ownership interests in the unincorporated entity in such number
    as to increase the percentage of ownership interests beneficially
    owned by the person and by any entities controlled by the person.

**[[11]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-11 .sectionLabel}** [\[Repealed, 2005, c. 54,
s. 216\]]{.Repealed}

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}WTO Member resident

- **[[11.1]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-11.1
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} For the purposes of this Act, a WTO
  Member resident is

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} a natural person who is ordinarily resident in a
    country or territory that is a WTO Member as defined in subsection
    2(1) of the [World Trade Organization Agreement Implementation
    Act](/eng/acts/W-11.8), other than Canada;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} a body corporate, association, partnership or other
    organization that is incorporated, formed or otherwise organized in
    a country or territory that is a WTO Member, as defined in
    subsection 2(1) of the [World Trade Organization Agreement
    Implementation Act](/eng/acts/W-11.8), other than Canada, and that
    is controlled,

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} directly or indirectly, by one or more persons
      referred to in paragraph (a), or

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} by a government of a WTO Member, whether
      federal, state or local, or an agency of one of those governments;

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} a trust established by one or more persons referred
    to in paragraph (a) or (b) or a trust in which one or more of those
    persons have more than 50 per cent of the beneficial interest; or

  - [(d)]{.lawlabel} a body corporate, association, partnership or other
    organization that is controlled, directly or indirectly, by a trust
    referred to in paragraph (c).

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Interpretation

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} For the purposes of subsection (1),

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} a body corporate is controlled by one or more
    persons if

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} securities of the body corporate to which are
      attached more than 50 per cent of the votes that may be cast to
      elect directors of the body corporate are beneficially owned by
      the person or persons, and

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} the votes attached to those securities are
      sufficient to elect a majority of the directors of the body
      corporate;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} an association, partnership or other organization
    is controlled by one or more persons if

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} more than 50 per cent of the ownership interests,
      however designated, into which the association, partnership or
      other organization is divided are beneficially owned by the person
      or persons, and

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} the person or persons are able to direct the
      business and affairs of the association, partnership or other
      organization;

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} a body corporate, association, partnership or other
    organization is controlled by one or more persons if the person or
    persons have, directly or indirectly, control in fact of the body
    corporate, association, partnership or other organization; and

  - [(d)]{.lawlabel} a body corporate, association, partnership or other
    organization that controls another body corporate, association,
    partnership or other organization is deemed to control any body
    corporate, association, partnership or other organization that is
    controlled or deemed to be controlled by the other body corporate,
    association, partnership or other organization.

::: HistoricalNote
- 1999, c. 28, s. 119
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Class of insurance

- **[[12]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-12 .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} A
  class of insurance is a class set out in the schedule.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Reference to particular class

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} A reference in this Act to a particular class of
  insurance is a reference to the insurance of risks falling within that
  particular class determined in accordance with subsections (3) to (6)
  and the schedule.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Property

  [(3)]{.lawlabel} A class of insurance that includes insurance against
  the loss of, or damage to, property includes insurance against loss of
  use, occupancy, rents and profits resulting from that loss or damage.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Personal injuries and death

  [(4)]{.lawlabel} Unless specifically mentioned in the schedule, no
  class of insurance includes insurance against liability arising out of
  bodily injury to, or the death of, a natural person or the loss of, or
  damage to, property.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Idem

  [(5)]{.lawlabel} A class of insurance that includes insurance against
  liability arising out of bodily injury to, or the death of, a natural
  person or the loss of, or damage to, property includes insurance
  against loss, damage or expenses incident to a claim giving rise to
  that liability.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Endowments

  [(6)]{.lawlabel} The class of life insurance includes the issuance of
  endowment insurance the funds of which are to be paid at a fixed or
  determinable future time if the person whose life is insured is then
  alive or at the person's death if the person dies before that time.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Amendment

  [(7)]{.lawlabel} The Governor in Council may, by order, amend
  subsections (3) to (5) and the schedule.

::: HistoricalNote
- 1991, c. 47, s. 12
- 2007, c. 6, s. 188
:::

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-12-20030101.html "Link to previous version of section 12"){.PITLink}
:::

### [Application]{.HTitleText2} {#h-257986 .Subheading}

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Application of Act

- **[[13]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-13 .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} This
  Act applies to every body corporate

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} that is incorporated or continued as a company
    under this Act, or

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} to which any of the provisions of Parts I, II, III
    and VII and either or both of Parts IV and VI of the Canadian and
    British Insurance Companies Act applied immediately before the
    coming into force of this section

  and that is not discontinued under this Act.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Application of certain provisions

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} This Part, Parts II to IV, sections 224, 225, 245 to
  258 and 489 and Parts X, XII, XV, XVI and XVIII to XX apply to every
  body corporate that is not discontinued under this Act and

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} that is incorporated or continued as a society
    under this Act; or

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} to which any of the provisions of Parts I and II,
    Part III, except section 77, Part IV, except sections 123 to 130 and
    153 to 158, and Parts V and VII of the Canadian and British
    Insurance Companies Act applied before June 1, 1992.

::: HistoricalNote
- 1991, c. 47, s. 13
- 1997, c. 15, s. 167
- 1999, c. 31, s. 138
- 2001, c. 9, s. 352
- 2005, c. 54, s. 217
:::

:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Conflicting provisions

**[[14]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-14 .sectionLabel}** Where there is a conflict
or inconsistency between a provision of this Act and a provision of the
incorporating instrument of a former-Act company or former-Act society,
the provision of this Act prevails.

## [PART II]{.HLabel1}[Status and Powers]{.HTitleText1} {#h-258001 .Part}

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Corporate powers

- **[[15]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-15 .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} A
  company or society has the capacity of a natural person and, subject
  to this Act, the rights, powers and privileges of a natural person.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Powers restricted

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} Neither a company nor a society shall carry on any
  business or exercise any power that it is restricted by this Act from
  carrying on or exercising, or exercise any of its powers in a manner
  contrary to this Act.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Business in Canada

  [(3)]{.lawlabel} A company or society may carry on business throughout
  Canada.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Powers outside Canada

  [(4)]{.lawlabel} Subject to this Act, a company or society has the
  capacity to carry on its business, conduct its affairs and exercise
  its powers in any jurisdiction outside Canada to the extent and in the
  manner that the laws of that jurisdiction permit.

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Policies and procedures --- integrity or
security

**[[15.1]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-15.1 .sectionLabel}** A company or society
shall establish and adhere to policies and procedures to protect itself
against threats to its integrity or security, including foreign
interference.

::: HistoricalNote
- [2023, c. 26, s. 578](#1411063-1437424){.wb-lbx
  aria-controls="centred-popup" ajax-after="1411063-1437424.html"
  role="button"}
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}No invalidity

**[[16]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-16 .sectionLabel}** No act of a company or
society, including any transfer of property to or by a company or
society, is invalid by reason only that the act or transfer is contrary
to the company's or society's incorporating instrument or this Act.

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}By-law not necessary

**[[17]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-17 .sectionLabel}** It is not necessary for a
company to pass a by-law in order to confer any particular power on the
company or its directors.

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}No personal liability

- **[[18]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-18 .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} The
  shareholders and participating policyholders of a company are not, as
  shareholders or policyholders, liable for any liability, act or
  default of the company except as otherwise provided by this Act.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Idem

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} The members of a society are not, as members, liable
  for any liability, act or default of the society except as otherwise
  provided by this Act.

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}No constructive notice

**[[19]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-19 .sectionLabel}** No person is affected by
or is deemed to have notice or knowledge of the contents of a document
concerning a company or society by reason only that the document has
been filed with the Superintendent or the Minister or is available for
inspection at an office of the company or society.

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Authority of directors and officers

- **[[20]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-20 .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} No
  company or society and no guarantor of an obligation of a company or
  society may assert against a person dealing with the company or
  society or against a person who has acquired rights from the company
  or society that

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the company's or society's incorporating instrument
    or any by-laws of the company or society have not been complied
    with;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} the persons named as directors of the company or
    society in the most recent return sent to the Superintendent under
    section 549 or 668 are not the directors of the company or society;

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} the place named in the incorporating instrument or
    by-laws of the company or society is not the place where the head
    office of the company or society is situated;

  - [(d)]{.lawlabel} a person held out by the company or society as a
    director, officer or representative of the company or society has
    not been duly appointed or has no authority to exercise the powers
    and perform the duties that are customary in the business of the
    company or society or usual for a director, officer or
    representative; or

  - [(e)]{.lawlabel} a document issued by any director, officer or
    representative of the company or society with actual or usual
    authority to issue the document is not valid or not genuine.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Exception --- knowledge

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} Subsection (1) does not apply in respect of a person
  who has or ought to have knowledge of a situation described in that
  subsection by virtue of their relationship to the company or society.

::: HistoricalNote
- 1991, c. 47, s. 20
- 2005, c. 54, s. 218
:::

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-20-20030101.html "Link to previous version of section 20"){.PITLink}
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Sunset provision

- **[[21]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-21
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} Subject to subsections (2) and (4),
  companies and societies shall not carry on business, and foreign
  companies shall not carry on business in Canada, after June 30, 2026.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Extension

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} The Governor in Council may, by order, extend by up
  to six months the time during which companies and societies may
  continue to carry on business and foreign companies may continue to
  carry on business in Canada. No more than one order may be made under
  this subsection.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Order not a regulation

  [(3)]{.lawlabel} The order is not a regulation for the purposes of the
  [Statutory Instruments Act](/eng/acts/S-22). However, it shall be
  published in Part II of the [Canada
  Gazette](http://www.gazette.gc.ca/).

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Exception --- dissolution

  [(4)]{.lawlabel} If Parliament dissolves on the day set out in
  subsection (1) or on any day within the six-month period before that
  day or on any day within an extension ordered under subsection (2),
  companies and societies may continue to carry on business, and foreign
  companies may continue to carry on business in Canada, until the end
  of the 180th day after the first day of the first session of the next
  Parliament.
