#### [Record Dates]{.HTitleText3} {#h-259249 .Subheading}

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Authority to fix record date

- **[[142]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-142 .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} The
  directors may in advance fix a record date, that is within the
  prescribed period, for the determination of

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} shareholders who are entitled to receive payment of
    a dividend;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} shareholders or policyholders who are entitled to
    participate in a liquidation distribution;

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} shareholders

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} who are entitled to receive notice of a meeting
      of shareholders or a meeting of shareholders and policyholders,

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} who are entitled to vote at a meeting of
      shareholders or at a meeting of shareholders and policyholders, or

    - [(iii)]{.lawlabel} for any other purpose;

  - [(d)]{.lawlabel} policyholders who are entitled to

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} receive notice of a meeting of policyholders or a
      meeting of shareholders and policyholders, or

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} vote at a meeting of policyholders or at a
      meeting of shareholders and policyholders; or

  - [(e)]{.lawlabel} policyholders for any other purpose except

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} the right to receive payment of a policy dividend
      or bonus,

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} any purpose where the determination of
      policyholders is governed by contract, and

    - [(iii)]{.lawlabel} the right to receive benefits in respect of the
      conversion of a mutual company into a company with common shares.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Determination of record date ---
  shareholders

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} If no record date is fixed,

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the record date for the determination of
    shareholders who are entitled to receive notice of a meeting of
    shareholders or a meeting of shareholders and policyholders is

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} at the close of business on the day immediately
      preceding the day on which the notice is given, or

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} if no notice is given, the day on which the
      meeting is held; and

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} the record date for the determination of
    shareholders for any other purpose, other than to establish a
    shareholder's right to vote, is at the close of business on the day
    on which the directors pass a resolution in respect of that purpose.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Determination of record date ---
  policyholders

  [(3)]{.lawlabel} If no record date is fixed,

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the record date for the determination of
    policyholders who are entitled to receive notice of a meeting of
    policyholders or a meeting of shareholders and policyholders is

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} at the close of business on the day immediately
      preceding the day on which the notice is given, or

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} if no notice is given, the day on which the
      meeting is held;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} the record date for the determination of
    policyholders entitled to vote at a meeting is the day on which the
    meeting is held; and

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} the record date for the determination of
    policyholders for any other purpose is at the close of business on
    the day on which the directors pass a resolution in respect of that
    purpose.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Notice of record date --- shareholders

  [(4)]{.lawlabel} If a record date is fixed and unless notice of the
  record date is waived in writing by every holder of a share of the
  class or series affected whose name is set out in the securities
  register at the close of business on the day on which the directors
  fix the record date, notice of the record date shall be given within
  the prescribed period by

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} advertisement in a newspaper in general circulation
    in the place where the company's head office is situated and in each
    place in Canada where the company has a transfer agent or where a
    transfer of its shares may be recorded; and

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} written notice to each stock exchange in Canada on
    which the company's shares are listed for trading.

- 1999, c. 1, s. 1
- 2005, c. 54, s. 230

#### [Notices of Meetings]{.HTitleText3} {#h-259285 .Subheading}

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Notice of meeting

- **[[143]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-143
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} Notice of the time and place of a
  meeting of a company's shareholders or policyholders shall be sent
  within the prescribed period to

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} each shareholder entitled to vote at the meeting;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} each policyholder who is determined under
    subsection (1.4) or (1.6) to be entitled to notice if no business
    referred to in subparagraphs (c)(i) to (iii) is to be dealt with;

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} each policyholder entitled to vote at the meeting
    if any of the following business is to be dealt with:

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} authorizing the company to apply to the Minister
      for approval of a mutualization proposal or amalgamation
      agreement,

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} confirming a by-law changing the rights of
      policyholders to vote at meetings or the province in which the
      head office of the company is situated, or

    - [(iii)]{.lawlabel} approving an agreement setting out the terms
      and means of effecting the transfer of all or substantially all of
      the company's policies or the reinsurance of all or substantially
      all of the company's policies;

  - [(d)]{.lawlabel} each director;

  - [(e)]{.lawlabel} the auditor of the company;

  - [(f)]{.lawlabel} the actuary of the company; and

  - [(g)]{.lawlabel} the Superintendent.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Exception

  [(1.001)]{.lawlabel} In the case of a company that is not a
  distributing company and does not have any policyholders entitled to
  vote, notice may be sent within any shorter period specified in its
  by-laws.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Number of eligible votes

  [(1.01)]{.lawlabel} A converted company in respect of which subsection
  407(4) applies or a company to which subsection 407(5) applies shall
  set out in the notice of a meeting the number of eligible votes, as
  defined under subsection 164.08(1), that may be cast at the meeting as
  of the record date for determining the shareholders or policyholders
  entitled to receive the notice of meeting or, if there are to be
  separate votes of shareholders or policyholders at the meeting, the
  number of eligible votes, as defined in that subsection, in respect of
  each separate vote to be held at the meeting.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Waiver of notice

  [(1.1)]{.lawlabel} A company is not required under subsection (1) to
  send to a person notice of a meeting if the person waives notice of
  the meeting. That waiver may be in any manner.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Attendance constitutes waiver

  [(1.2)]{.lawlabel} A person who attends a meeting of shareholders or
  policyholders is deemed to have waived notice of the meeting, except
  where the person attends the meeting for the express purpose of
  objecting to the transaction of any business on the grounds that the
  meeting is not lawfully called.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Practices of policyholder notification

  [(1.3)]{.lawlabel} A company shall adopt and follow either of the two
  practices set out in subsections (1.4) and (1.5) for the notification
  of policyholders under paragraph (1)(b).

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}First practice

  [(1.4)]{.lawlabel} One practice requires the company to send the
  notice to each policyholder entitled to vote at the meeting. If that
  practice is adopted, each of those policyholders is entitled to notice
  under paragraph (1)(b).

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Second practice

  [(1.5)]{.lawlabel} The other practice requires the company, at the
  time of the application for or issuance of a policy that gives the
  policyholder the right to vote at meetings of the shareholders and
  policyholders of the company, and after that time at least once every
  three years,

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} to advise the policyholder of the policyholder's
    right to attend and to vote in person or by proxy at those meetings;
    and

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} to provide the policyholder with a form on which
    the policyholder may indicate whether the policyholder wants to
    receive notices of those meetings.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Notice under second practice

  [(1.6)]{.lawlabel} If a company chooses the practice under subsection
  (1.5), each policyholder entitled to vote at a meeting is entitled to
  notice under paragraph (1)(b) if, within three years before the record
  date fixed under subparagraph 142(1)(d)(i) or determined under
  paragraph 142(3)(a), they complete and return to the company the form
  referred to in paragraph (1.5)(b) indicating that they want to receive
  notice or they indicate to the satisfaction of the company that they
  want to receive notice.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Exemption

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} The Minister may exempt a company from the
  application of paragraph (1)(c) with respect to business consisting of
  the approval of an amalgamation agreement, having regard to the size
  of the company and of the companies or bodies corporate with which it
  proposes to amalgamate.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Publication in newspaper

  [(3)]{.lawlabel} In addition to the notice required under subsection
  (1),

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} where any class of shares of a company is publicly
    traded on a recognized stock exchange in Canada, notice of the time
    and place of the meeting of shareholders shall be published once a
    week for at least four consecutive weeks before the date of the
    meeting in a newspaper in the place where the head office of the
    company is situated and in each place in Canada where the company
    has a transfer agent or where a transfer of the company's shares may
    be recorded; or

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} notice of the time and place of the meeting of
    policyholders of the company and, where a company follows the
    practice under subsection (1.5), information on the means by which
    any policyholder can receive the notice required under subsection
    (1), shall be published once a week for at least four consecutive
    weeks before the date of the meeting in a newspaper in the place
    where the head office of the company is situated and in each region
    of Canada in which more than one per cent of the total number of
    policyholders entitled to vote at the meeting reside.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Notice not required --- shareholders

  [(4)]{.lawlabel} Notice of a meeting is not required to be sent to
  shareholders who are not registered on the records of the company or
  the company's transfer agent on the record date fixed under
  subparagraph 142(1)(c)(i) or determined under paragraph 142(2)(a).

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Notice not required --- policyholders

  [(5)]{.lawlabel} Notice of a meeting at which business referred to in
  paragraph (1)(c) is to be dealt with is not required to be sent to
  policyholders who become policyholders after the record date fixed
  under subparagraph 142(1)(d)(i) or determined under paragraph
  142(3)(a).

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Effect of default

  [(6)]{.lawlabel} Failure to receive a notice of a meeting of
  shareholders or policyholders does not deprive a shareholder or
  policyholder of the right to vote at the meeting.

::: HistoricalNote
- 1991, c. 47, s. 143
- 1993, c. 34, s. 78
- 1997, c. 15, s. 187
- 1999, c. 1, s. 2
- 2001, c. 9, s. 370
- 2005, c. 54, s. 231
:::

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-143-20030101.html "Link to previous version of section 143"){.PITLink}
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Notice of adjourned meeting

- **[[144]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-144 .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} If a
  meeting of shareholders or policyholders is adjourned for less than
  thirty days, it is not necessary, unless the by-laws otherwise
  provide, to give notice of the adjourned meeting, other than by
  announcement at the earliest meeting that is adjourned.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Notice after longer adjournment

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} If a meeting of shareholders or policyholders is
  adjourned by one or more adjournments for a total of thirty days or
  more, notice of the continuation of the meeting shall be given as for
  an original meeting but, unless the meeting is adjourned by one or
  more adjournments for a total of more than ninety days, subsection
  164.03(1) does not apply.

::: HistoricalNote
- 1991, c. 47, s. 144
- 1997, c. 15, s. 188
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Special business

- **[[145]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-145 .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} All
  matters dealt with at a special meeting of shareholders or
  policyholders or at an annual meeting of shareholders and
  policyholders are deemed to be special business, except that special
  business does not include consideration of

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the financial statements;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} the auditor's report;

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} the actuary's report;

  - [(d)]{.lawlabel} the election of directors;

  - [(e)]{.lawlabel} the remuneration of directors and reappointment of
    the incumbent auditor; or

  - [(f)]{.lawlabel} the description of the roles of the actuary and the
    auditor in the preparation and audit of the financial statements.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Notice of special business

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} Notice of a meeting of shareholders or policyholders
  at which special business is to be transacted must

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} state the nature of the special business in
    sufficient detail to permit a shareholder or policyholder to form a
    reasoned judgment thereon;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} contain the text of any special resolution to be
    submitted to the meeting; and

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} state, where a management proxy circular is sent to
    shareholders concurrently with the notice, that a policyholder is
    entitled on request to receive a copy of the management proxy
    circular.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Exemption

  [(3)]{.lawlabel} The Superintendent may exempt a company from the
  application of paragraph (2)(b) in relation to policyholders, on
  condition that, instead of sending the policyholders the text of a
  special resolution to be submitted to a meeting, the company send the
  policyholders a summary of the text.

::: HistoricalNote
- 1991, c. 47, s. 145
- 1997, c. 15, s. 189
:::

**[[146]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-146 .sectionLabel}** [\[Repealed, 1997, c.
15, s. 190\]]{.Repealed}

#### [Shareholder and Policyholder Proposals]{.HTitleText3} {#h-259357 .Subheading}

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Proposal

- **[[147]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-147
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} Subject to subsections (1.1) and
  (1.2), a registered holder or beneficial owner of shares that may be
  voted --- or a policyholder entitled to vote --- at an annual meeting
  of shareholders and policyholders may

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} submit to the company notice of any matter that
    they propose to raise at the meeting (in this section and section
    148 referred to as a "proposal"); and

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} discuss at the meeting any matter in respect of
    which they would have been entitled to submit a proposal.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Eligibility to submit proposal

  [(1.1)]{.lawlabel} To be eligible to submit a proposal a person shall

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} for at least the prescribed period be the
    registered holder or beneficial owner of at least the prescribed
    number of the company's outstanding shares;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} have the support of persons who, in the aggregate
    and including or not including the person who submits the proposal,
    have for at least the prescribed period been the registered holders
    or beneficial owners of at least the prescribed number of the
    company's outstanding shares; or

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} be a policyholder entitled to vote at an annual
    meeting of the company's shareholders and policyholders.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Information to be provided

  [(1.2)]{.lawlabel} A proposal submitted by a registered holder or
  beneficial owner is to be accompanied by the following information:

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the name and address of the person submitting the
    proposal and the names and addresses of their supporters, if any;
    and

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} the number of shares held or owned by the person
    and their supporters, if any, and the date that the shares were
    acquired.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Information not part of proposal

  [(1.3)]{.lawlabel} The information provided under subsection (1.2)
  does not form part of a proposal or of the supporting statement
  referred to in subsection (3) and is not to be included for the
  purpose of the prescribed maximum number of words referred to in
  subsection (3).

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Proof may be required

  [(1.4)]{.lawlabel} If the company requests within the prescribed
  period that a person provide proof that they are eligible to submit a
  proposal, the person shall within the prescribed period provide proof
  that they meet the requirements of subsection (1.1).

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Circulation of proposal

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} A company shall attach any proposal of a shareholder
  or policyholder submitted for consideration at a meeting of
  shareholders and policyholders to the notice of the meeting.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Supporting statement

  [(3)]{.lawlabel} At the request of the person who submits a proposal,
  the company shall attach to the notice of the meeting the person's
  statement in support of the proposal and their name and address. The
  statement and proposal together are not to exceed the prescribed
  maximum number of words.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Nomination of directors

  [(4)]{.lawlabel} A proposal may include nominations for the election
  of directors if it is signed by

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} in the case of nominations for the directors to be
    elected by shareholders, one or more registered holders or
    beneficial owners of shares representing in the aggregate not less
    than 5% of the shares of the company or 5% of the shares of a class
    of its shares entitled to vote at the meeting at which the proposal
    is to be presented; and

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} in the case of nominations for the directors to be
    elected by policyholders, the lesser of 250 policyholders and 1% of
    the policyholders who are entitled to vote at the meeting.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Conditions precedent for proposals

  [(5)]{.lawlabel} A company is not required to comply with
  subsections (2) and (3) if

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the proposal is not submitted to the company at
    least the prescribed number of days before the anniversary date of
    the notice of meeting that was sent to shareholders and
    policyholders in respect of the previous annual meeting of
    shareholders and policyholders;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} it clearly appears that the primary purpose of the
    proposal is to enforce a personal claim or redress a personal
    griev­ance against the company or its directors, officers or security
    holders;

  - [(b.1)]{.lawlabel} it clearly appears that the proposal does not
    relate in a significant way to the business or affairs of the
    company;

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} the person submitting the proposal failed within
    the prescribed period before the company receives their proposal to
    present, in person or by proxy, at a meeting of shareholders or
    policyholders a proposal that at their request had been attached to
    a notice of meeting;

  - [(d)]{.lawlabel} substantially the same proposal was set out in or
    attached to a dissident's proxy circular or attached to a notice of
    meeting relating to, and was presented to shareholders or
    policyholders at, a meeting of shareholders or policyholders held
    within the prescribed period before the receipt of the proposal and
    did not receive the prescribed minimum amount of support at the
    meeting;

  - [(e)]{.lawlabel} the rights conferred by subsections (1) to (4) are
    being abused to secure publicity;

  - [(f)]{.lawlabel} in the case of a proposal submitted by a
    policyholder that relates to business that is referred to in
    paragraph 143(1)(c), the proposal is not signed by at least five
    hundred policyholders entitled to vote at the meeting to which the
    proposal is to be presented, or one per cent of the total number of
    those policyholders, whichever is lesser;

  - [(g)]{.lawlabel} in the case of any other proposal submitted by a
    policyholder, the proposal is not signed by at least one hundred
    policyholders entitled to vote at the meeting to which the proposal
    is to be presented;

  - [(h)]{.lawlabel} in the case of a proposal submitted by a
    policyholder, the proposal

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} relates to the management of the ordinary
      business and affairs of the company, or

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} would, if implemented, result in a change in the
      character or direction of the company that would have a material
      adverse effect on the ability of the company to meet the
      reasonable expectations of the company's participating
      policyholders as to the net cost of their insurance; or

    - [(iii)]{.lawlabel} [\[Repealed, 1996, c. 6, s. 72\]]{.Repealed}

  - [(i)]{.lawlabel} in the case of a proposal submitted by a
    policyholder or a shareholder of a mutual company, the proposal
    would result in the mutual company being converted into a company
    with common shares.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Company may refuse to include proposal

  [(5.1)]{.lawlabel} If a person who submits a proposal fails to
  continue to hold or own shares in accordance with paragraph (1.1)(a)
  or, as the case may be, does not continue to have the support of
  persons who are in the aggregate the registered holders or beneficial
  owners of the prescribed number of shares in accordance with paragraph
  (1.1)(b) until the end of the meeting, the company is not required to
  attach any proposal submitted by that person to a notice of meeting
  for any meeting held within the prescribed period after the day of the
  meeting.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Immunity for proposal and statement

  [(6)]{.lawlabel} No company or person acting on behalf of a company
  incurs any liability by reason only of circulating a proposal or
  statement in compliance with subsections (2) and (3).

::: HistoricalNote
- 1991, c. 47, s. 147
- 1996, c. 6, s. 72
- 1997, c. 15, s. 191
- 2001, c. 9, s. 371(F)
- 2005, c. 54, s. 232
:::

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-147-20030101.html "Link to previous version of section 147"){.PITLink}
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Notice of refusal

- **[[148]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-148 .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} If a
  company refuses to attach a proposal to a notice of a meeting, it
  shall in writing notify the person submitting the proposal of its
  intention not to attach the proposal to the notice of the meeting and
  of the reasons for the refusal. It shall notify the person within the
  prescribed period after either the day on which it receives the
  proposal or, if it has requested proof under subsection 147(1.4), the
  day on which it receives the proof.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Application to court

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} On the application of a person submitting a proposal
  who claims to be aggrieved by a company's refusal under subsection
  (1), a court may restrain the holding of the meeting at which the
  proposal is sought to be presented and make any further order that it
  thinks fit.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Idem

  [(3)]{.lawlabel} A company or any person claiming to be aggrieved by a
  proposal may apply to a court for an order permitting the company not
  to attach the proposal to the notice of the meeting, and the court, if
  it is satisfied that subsection 147(5) applies, may make such order as
  it thinks fit.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Notice to Superintendent

  [(4)]{.lawlabel} An applicant under subsection (2) or (3) shall give
  the Superintendent written notice of the application and the
  Superintendent may appear and be heard at the hearing of the
  application in person or by counsel.

::: HistoricalNote
- 1991, c. 47, s. 148
- 2005, c. 54, s. 233
:::

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-148-20030101.html "Link to previous version of section 148"){.PITLink}
:::

#### [Shareholder and Policyholder Lists]{.HTitleText3} {#h-259416 .Subheading}

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Lists of shareholders and policyholders

- **[[149]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-149 .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} A
  company shall prepare an alphabetical list

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} of shareholders entitled to receive notice of a
    meeting showing the number of shares held by each shareholder

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} if a record date is fixed under subparagraph
      142(1)(c)(i), no later than 10 days after that date, and

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} if no record date is fixed, on the record date
      determined under paragraph 142(2)(a); and

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} of policyholders entitled to vote at a meeting

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} if a record date is fixed under subparagraph
      142(1)(d)(ii), no later than the day on which the meeting is held,
      and

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} if no record date is fixed, on the record date
      determined under paragraph 142(3)(b).

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Shareholder voting list

  [(1.1)]{.lawlabel} The company shall prepare an alphabetical list of
  shareholders entitled to vote as of the record date showing the number
  of shares held by each shareholder

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} if a record date is fixed under subparagraph
    142(1)(c)(ii), no later than 10 days after that date; and

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} if no record date is fixed under subparagraph
    142(1)(c)(ii), no later than 10 days after a record date is fixed
    under subparagraph 142(1)(c)(i) or no later than the record date
    determined under paragraph 142(2)(a), as the case may be.

- [(1.2)]{.lawlabel} [\[Repealed, 2005, c. 54, s. 234\]]{.Repealed}

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Entitlement to vote --- shareholders

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} Subject to section 164.08, a shareholder whose name
  appears on a list prepared under subsection (1.1) is entitled to vote
  the shares shown opposite their name.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Entitlement to vote --- policyholders

  [(3)]{.lawlabel} A policyholder whose name appears on a list prepared
  under paragraph (1)(b) is entitled to vote at the meeting to which the
  list relates.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Examination of shareholder list

  [(4)]{.lawlabel} A shareholder or policyholder may examine the list of
  shareholders

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} during usual business hours at the head office of
    the company or at the place where its central securities register is
    maintained; and

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} at the meeting of shareholders for which the list
    was prepared.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Verification of right of policyholder
  to vote

  [(5)]{.lawlabel} A shareholder or policyholder of a company may, at
  the meeting of policyholders for which the list referred to in
  subsection (1) was prepared, require the company to verify from that
  list whether a person identified both by name and by some other
  distinguishing feature is entitled to vote at that meeting.

::: HistoricalNote
- 1991, c. 47, s. 149
- 1997, c. 15, s. 192
- 1999, c. 1, s. 3
- 2005, c. 54, s. 234
:::

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-149-20030101.html "Link to previous version of section 149"){.PITLink}
:::

#### [Quorum]{.HTitleText3} {#h-259443 .Subheading}

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Shareholders

- **[[150]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-150
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} Unless the by-laws otherwise
  provide, a quorum of shareholders is present at a meeting of
  shareholders if the holders of a majority of the shares who are
  entitled to vote at the meeting are present in person or represented
  by proxyholders.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Policyholders

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} Unless the by-laws otherwise provide, a quorum of
  policyholders is present at a meeting of policyholders if at least
  five hundred policyholders who are entitled to vote at the meeting, or
  one per cent of the total number of those policyholders, whichever is
  lesser, are present in person or represented by proxyholders.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Shareholders and policyholders

  [(3)]{.lawlabel} Unless the by-laws otherwise provide, a quorum of
  shareholders and policyholders is present at a meeting of shareholders
  and policyholders if the holders of a majority of the shares and at
  least five hundred policyholders, or one per cent of the total number
  of policyholders, whichever is lesser, who are entitled to vote at the
  meeting are present in person or represented by proxyholders.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Quorum at opening

  [(4)]{.lawlabel} If a quorum is present at the opening of a meeting of
  shareholders or policyholders, the shareholders or policyholders
  present may, unless the by-laws otherwise provide, proceed with the
  business of the meeting, notwithstanding that a quorum is not present
  throughout the meeting.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}No quorum at opening

  [(5)]{.lawlabel} If a quorum is not present at the opening of a
  meeting of shareholders or policyholders, the shareholders or
  policyholders present may adjourn the meeting to a fixed time and
  place but may not transact any other business.

::: HistoricalNote
- 1991, c. 47, s. 150
- 2001, c. 9, s. 372
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}One shareholder meeting

**[[151]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-151 .sectionLabel}** If a company has only
one shareholder, or only one holder of any class or series of shares,
the shareholder present in person or represented by a proxyholder
constitutes a meeting of shareholders or a meeting of shareholders of
that class or series.

#### [Voting]{.HTitleText3} {#h-259459 .Subheading}

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}One share --- one vote

**[[152]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-152 .sectionLabel}** Subject to section
164.08, if a share of a company entitles the holder of the share to vote
at a meeting of shareholders or shareholders and policyholders, that
share entitles the shareholder to one vote at the meeting.

::: HistoricalNote
- 1991, c. 47, s. 152
- 2001, c. 9, s. 373
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}One vote for each participating
policyholder

- **[[153]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-153
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} Subject to subsection 149(3), the
  holder of one or more participating policies issued by a company is
  entitled to attend a meeting of policyholders or shareholders and
  policyholders of the company and is entitled to one vote at that
  meeting.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Exception

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} Notwithstanding subsection (1) but subject to
  subsection 149(3), the holder of a participating policy that was
  issued by a former-Act company before June 1, 1992 is entitled to more
  than one vote, or to a fraction of a vote, at a meeting of
  policyholders or shareholders and policyholders of the company in
  accordance with the terms of the policy or the provisions of the
  incorporating instrument or the by-laws of the company that had not
  been repealed and had not otherwise ceased to have effect before that
  date.

::: HistoricalNote
- 1991, c. 47, s. 153
- 1997, c. 15, s. 193
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Other policyholders entitled to vote

- **[[154]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-154
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} Subject to subsection 149(3), the
  holder of one or more policies, other than participating policies,
  issued by a company is entitled to attend a meeting of policyholders
  or shareholders and policyholders of the company, and is entitled to
  one vote at that meeting, where

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the terms of one or more of those policies entitle
    the policyholder to vote at the meeting; or

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} the by-laws of the company entitle the policyholder
    to vote at the meeting.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Exception

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} Notwithstanding subsection (1) but subject to
  subsection 149(3), the holder of a policy, other than a participating
  policy, that was issued by a former-Act company before June 1, 1992 is
  entitled to more than one vote, or to a fraction of a vote, at a
  meeting of policyholders or shareholders and policyholders of the
  company in accordance with the terms of the policy or the provisions
  of the incorporating instrument or the by-laws of the company that had
  not been repealed and had not otherwise ceased to have effect before
  that date.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}One policyholder --- one vote

  [(3)]{.lawlabel} Subject to subsection 149(3), the holder of one or
  more participating policies issued by a company and one or more
  policies, other than participating policies, referred to in subsection
  (1)

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} is entitled to one vote as the holder of one or
    more participating policies and to another vote as the holder of one
    or more policies, other than participating policies, referred to in
    that subsection where this Act provides for participating
    policyholders to vote separately from other policyholders who are
    entitled to vote, or for those other policyholders to vote
    separately from participating policyholders;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} is not otherwise entitled to more than one vote at
    a meeting of policyholders; and

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} is not otherwise entitled to more than one vote at
    a meeting of shareholders and policyholders, unless the holder is
    also a shareholder, in which case the holder is entitled to one vote
    as a policyholder and is also entitled to vote his or her shares.

::: HistoricalNote
- 1991, c. 47, s. 154
- 1997, c. 15, s. 194
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Representative shareholder or
policyholder

- **[[155]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-155 .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} If
  an entity is a shareholder or policyholder of a company, the company
  shall recognize any natural person authorized by a resolution of the
  directors or governing body or similar authority of the entity to
  represent it at meetings of shareholders or policyholders of the
  company.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Idem

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} A natural person authorized under subsection (1) to
  represent an entity may exercise on behalf of the entity all the
  powers the entity could exercise if the entity were a natural person
  who was a shareholder or policyholder.

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Joint shareholders or policyholders

**[[156]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-156 .sectionLabel}** Unless the by-laws
otherwise provide, if two or more persons hold shares or policies
jointly, one of those holders present at a meeting of shareholders or
policyholders may in the absence of the others vote the shares or
policies, but if two or more of those persons who are present in person
or represented by proxyholder vote, they shall vote as one on the shares
or policies jointly held by them.

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Voting by hands or ballot

- **[[157]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-157
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} Unless the by-laws otherwise
  provide, voting at a meeting of shareholders or policyholders shall
  take place by show of hands except when a ballot is demanded by a
  shareholder, policyholder or proxyholder entitled to vote at the
  meeting.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Ballot

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} A shareholder, policyholder or proxyholder may demand
  a ballot either before or after any vote by show of hands.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Electronic voting

  [(3)]{.lawlabel} Despite subsection (1) and unless the by-laws provide
  otherwise, any vote referred to in that subsection may be held
  entirely by means of a telephonic, electronic or other communication
  facility if the company makes one available.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Voting while participating
  electronically

  [(4)]{.lawlabel} Unless the by-laws provide otherwise, any person who
  is participating in a meeting of shareholders or policyholders under
  subsection 140(2) and entitled to vote at that meeting may vote by
  means of the telephonic, electronic or other communication facility
  that the company has made available for that purpose.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Regulations

  [(5)]{.lawlabel} The Governor in Council may make regulations
  respecting the manner of and conditions for voting at a meeting of
  shareholders or policyholders by means of a telephonic, electronic or
  other communication facility.

::: HistoricalNote
- 1991, c. 47, s. 157
- 2005, c. 54, s. 235
:::

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-157-20030101.html "Link to previous version of section 157"){.PITLink}
:::

#### [Resolution in lieu of Meeting]{.HTitleText3} {#h-259505 .Subheading}

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Resolution in lieu of meeting

- **[[158]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-158
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} Except where a written statement is
  submitted by a director under section 182 or by an auditor under
  subsection 344(1),

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} a resolution in writing signed by all the
    shareholders and policyholders entitled to vote on that resolution
    at a meeting of shareholders or policyholders is as valid as if it
    had been passed at a meeting of the shareholders or policyholders;
    and

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} a resolution in writing dealing with all matters
    required by this Act to be dealt with at a meeting of shareholders
    or policyholders, and signed by all the shareholders and
    policyholders entitled to vote at that meeting, satisfies all the
    requirements of this Act relating to meetings of shareholders or
    policyholders.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Filing resolution

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} A copy of every resolution referred to in
  subsection (1) shall be kept with the minutes of the meetings of
  shareholders or policyholders.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Evidence

  [(3)]{.lawlabel} Unless a ballot is demanded, an entry in the minutes
  of a meeting that the chairperson declared a resolution to be carried
  or defeated is in the absence of evidence to the contrary proof of
  that fact without proof of the number or proportion of votes recorded
  in favour of or against the resolution.

::: HistoricalNote
- 1991, c. 47, s. 158
- 2005, c. 54, s. 236
:::

Version](section-158-20030101.html "Link to previous version of section 158"){.PITLink}
:::

#### [Requisitioned Meetings]{.HTitleText3} {#h-259517 .Subheading}

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Requisitioned meeting

- **[[159]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-159
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} Shareholders who together hold not
  less than 5 per cent of the issued and outstanding shares of a company
  that carry the right to vote at a meeting sought to be held may
  requisition the directors to call a meeting of shareholders or
  shareholders and policyholders for the purposes stated in the
  requisition.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Idem

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} At least five hundred policyholders entitled to vote
  at a meeting sought to be held, or one per cent of the total number of
  those policyholders, whichever is greater, may requisition the
  directors to call a meeting of policyholders or shareholders and
  policyholders for the purposes stated in the requisition.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Form

  [(3)]{.lawlabel} A requisition referred to in subsection (1) or (2)

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} must state the business to be transacted at the
    meeting and must be sent to each director and to the head office of
    the company; and

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} may consist of several documents of like form, each
    signed by one or more shareholders or policyholders.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Directors calling meeting

  [(4)]{.lawlabel} On receipt of a requisition referred to in
  subsection (1) or (2), the directors shall call a meeting of
  shareholders or policyholders to transact the business stated in the
  requisition, unless

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} a record date has been fixed under subparagraph
    142(1)(c)(i) or (d)(i) and notice of it has been given under
    subsection 142(4);

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} the directors have called a meeting of shareholders
    or policyholders and have given notice thereof under section 143; or

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} the business of the meeting as stated in the
    requisition includes matters described in paragraphs 147(5)(b) to
    (e), (h) and (i).

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Shareholders' and policyholders' power

  [(5)]{.lawlabel} If the directors do not call a meeting within
  twenty-one days after receiving a requisition referred to in
  subsection (1) or (2), any shareholder or policyholder who signed the
  requisition may call the meeting.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Procedure

  [(6)]{.lawlabel} A meeting called under this section shall be called
  as nearly as possible in the manner in which meetings are to be called
  pursuant to the by-laws and this Act.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Reimbursement

  [(7)]{.lawlabel} Unless the shareholders or policyholders otherwise
  resolve at a meeting called under subsection (5), the company shall
  reimburse the shareholders or policyholders for any expenses
  reasonably incurred by them in requisitioning, calling and holding the
  meeting.

::: HistoricalNote
- 1991, c. 47, s. 159
- 1997, c. 15, s. 195
- 2005, c. 54, s. 237
:::

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-159-20030101.html "Link to previous version of section 159"){.PITLink}
:::

#### [Powers of the Court]{.HTitleText3} {#h-259540 .Subheading}

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Court may order meeting to be called

- **[[160]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-160 .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} A
  court may, on the application of a director, a shareholder or
  policyholder who is entitled to vote or the Superintendent, order a
  meeting to be called, held or conducted in the manner that the court
  directs if

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} it is impracticable to call the meeting within the
    time or in the manner in which it is to be called;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} it is impracticable to conduct the meeting in the
    manner required by this Act or the by-laws; or

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} the court thinks that the meeting ought to be
    called, held or conducted within the time or in the manner that it
    directs for any other reason.

- [(1.1)]{.lawlabel} [\[Repealed, 2005, c. 54, s. 238\]]{.Repealed}

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Varying quorum

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} Without restricting the generality of subsection (1),
  a court may order that the quorum required by the by-laws or this Act
  be varied or dispensed with at a meeting called, held and conducted
  pursuant to this section.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Valid meeting

  [(3)]{.lawlabel} A meeting called, held and conducted pursuant to this
  section is for all purposes a meeting of shareholders or policyholders
  of the company duly called, held and conducted.

::: HistoricalNote
- 1991, c. 47, s. 160
- 1997, c. 15, s. 196
- 2005, c. 54, s. 238
:::

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-160-20030101.html "Link to previous version of section 160"){.PITLink}
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Court review of election

- **[[161]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-161 .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} A
  company or a shareholder, policyholder or director of a company may
  apply to a court to resolve any dispute in respect of the election or
  appointment of a director or an auditor of the company.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Powers of court

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} On an application under subsection (1), a court may
  make any order it thinks fit including, without limiting the
  generality of the foregoing,

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} an order restraining a director or auditor whose
    election or appointment is challenged from acting pending
    determination of the dispute;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} an order declaring the result of the disputed
    election or appointment;

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} an order requiring a new election or appointment,
    and including in the order directions for the management of the
    business and affairs of the company until a new election is held or
    the new appointment is made; and

  - [(d)]{.lawlabel} an order determining the voting rights of
    shareholders, persons claiming to own shares, policyholders and
    persons claiming to be policyholders.

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Notice to Superintendent

- **[[162]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-162 .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} A
  person who makes an application under subsection 160(1) or 161(1)
  shall give notice of the application to the Superintendent before the
  hearing and shall deliver a copy of the order of the court, if any, to
  the Superintendent.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Superintendent representation

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} The Superintendent may appear and be heard in person
  or by counsel at the hearing of an application referred to in
  subsection (1).

#### [Pooling Agreements]{.HTitleText3} {#h-259568 .Subheading}

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Pooling agreement

**[[163]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-163 .sectionLabel}** A written agreement
between two or more shareholders or policyholders may provide that in
exercising voting rights the shares or policies held by them will be
voted as provided in the agreement.

### [DIVISION I.1]{.HLabel2}[Proxies]{.HTitleText2} {#h-259571 .Subheading}

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Definitions

**[[164]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-164 .sectionLabel}** The definitions in this
section apply in this Division.

[[intermediary]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[intermediary]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a person who holds a
    security on behalf of another person who is not the registered
    holder of the security, and includes

    - [(a)]{.lawlabel} a securities broker or dealer required to be
      registered to trade or deal in securities under the laws of any
      jurisdiction;

    - [(b)]{.lawlabel} a securities depositary;

    - [(c)]{.lawlabel} a financial institution;

    - [(d)]{.lawlabel} in relation to a clearing agency, a securities
      dealer, trust company, association within the meaning of section 2
      of the [Cooperative Credit Associations Act](/eng/acts/C-41.01),
      bank or other person, including another clearing agency, on whose
      behalf the clearing agency or its nominee holds securities of an
      issuer;

    - [(e)]{.lawlabel} a trustee or administrator of a self-administered
      retirement savings plan, retirement income fund or education
      savings plan or another similar self-administered savings or
      investment plan registered under the [Income Tax
      Act](/eng/acts/I-3.3);

    - [(f)]{.lawlabel} a nominee of a person referred to in any of
      paragraphs (a) to (e); and

    - [(g)]{.lawlabel} a person who performs functions similar to those
      performed by a person referred to in any of paragraphs (a) to (e)
      and holds a security registered in their name, or in the name of
      their nominee, on behalf of another person who is not the
      registered holder of the
      security. ([intermédiaire]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[registrant]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[registrant]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}[\[Repealed, 2005, c. 54, s.
    239\]]{.Repealed}

[[solicitation]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[solicitation]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

    - [(a)]{.lawlabel} includes

      - [(i)]{.lawlabel} a request for a proxy whether or not
        accompanied by or included in a form of proxy,

      - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} a request to execute or not to execute or, in
        Quebec, to sign or not to sign a form of proxy or to revoke a
        proxy,

      - [(iii)]{.lawlabel} the sending of a form of proxy or other
        communication to a shareholder or policyholder under
        circumstances reasonably calculated to result in the
        procurement, withholding or revocation of a proxy, and

      - [(iv)]{.lawlabel} the sending of a form of proxy to a
        shareholder or policyholder under section 164.03; but

    - [(b)]{.lawlabel} does not include

      - [(i)]{.lawlabel} the sending of a form of proxy in response to
        an unsolicited request made by or on behalf of a shareholder or
        policyholder,

      - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} the performance of administrative acts or
        professional services on behalf of a person soliciting a proxy,

      - [(iii)]{.lawlabel} the sending by an intermediary of the
        documents referred to in subsection 164.06(1),

      - [(iv)]{.lawlabel} a solicitation by a person in respect of
        shares of which they are the beneficial owner,

      - [(v)]{.lawlabel} a prescribed public announcement by a
        shareholder or policyholder of how they intend to vote and the
        reasons for that decision,

      - [(vi)]{.lawlabel} a communication for the purposes of obtaining
        the support of persons in accord­ance with paragraph 147(1.1)(b),
        or

      - [(vii)]{.lawlabel} a communication, other than a solic­itation by
        or on behalf of the management of a company, that is made to
        shareholders or policyholders in the prescribed
        circumstances. ([sollicitation]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

[[solicitation by or on behalf of the management of a company]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

:   [[solicitation by or on behalf of the management of a
    company]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means a solicitation by any person
    pursuant to a resolution or instruction of, or with the acquiescence
    of, the directors or a committee of the directors of the
    company. ([sollicitation effectuée par la direction d'une société ou
    pour son compte]{.DefinedTermLink lang="fr"})

::: HistoricalNote
- 1991, c. 47, s. 164
- 1997, c. 15, s. 197
- 2005, c. 54, s. 239
- [2022, c. 10, s. 229(E)](#1357192-1485905){.wb-lbx
  aria-controls="centred-popup" ajax-after="1357192-1485905.html"
  role="button"}
:::

Version](section-164-20061128.html "Link to previous version of section 164"){.PITLink}
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Appointing proxyholder

- **[[164.01]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-164.01
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} A shareholder or policyholder who is
  entitled to vote at a meeting of shareholders or policyholders may, by
  executing a form of proxy, appoint a proxyholder or one or more
  alternate proxyholders, who are not required to be shareholders or
  policyholders, to attend and act at the meeting in the manner and to
  the extent authorized by the proxy and with the authority conferred by
  the proxy.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Execution of proxy

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} A form of proxy shall be executed by a shareholder or
  policyholder or by a shareholder's or policyholder's attorney
  authorized in writing to do so.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Limit on authority

  [(3)]{.lawlabel} No appointment of a proxyholder provides authority
  for the proxyholder to act in respect of the appointment of an auditor
  or the election of a director unless a nominee proposed in good faith
  for the appointment or election is named in the form of proxy, a
  management proxy circular, a dissident's proxy circular or a proposal
  under subsection 147(1).

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Required information

  [(4)]{.lawlabel} A form of proxy must indicate, in bold-face type,
  that the shareholder or policyholder by whom or on whose behalf it is
  executed may appoint a proxyholder, other than a person designated in
  the form of proxy, to attend and act on the shareholder's or
  policyholder's behalf at a meeting to which the proxy relates, and
  must contain instructions as to the manner in which the shareholder or
  policyholder may do so.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Validity of proxy

  [(5)]{.lawlabel} A proxy is valid only at the meeting in respect of
  which it is given or at a continuation of the meeting after an
  adjournment.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Revocation of proxy

  [(6)]{.lawlabel} A shareholder or policyholder may revoke a proxy

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} by depositing an instrument in writing executed by
    the shareholder or policyholder or by the shareholder's or
    policyholder's attorney authorized in writing to do so

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} at the head office of the company at any time up
      to and including the last business day before the day of a
      meeting, or a continuation of a meeting after an adjournment, at
      which the proxy is to be used, or

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} with the chairperson of the meeting on the day
      of the meeting or a continuation of the meeting after an
      adjournment; or

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} in any other manner permitted by law.

::: HistoricalNote
- 1997, c. 15, s. 197
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Deposit of proxies

- **[[164.02]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-164.02
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} The directors may specify, in a
  notice calling a meeting of shareholders or policyholders or a
  continuation of a meeting of shareholders or policyholders after an
  adjournment, a time before which executed forms of proxy to be used at
  the meeting or the continued meeting must be deposited with the
  company or its transfer agent.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Time for deposit of proxies

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} The time specified for the deposit of forms of proxy
  may not precede the meeting or the continued meeting by more than

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} forty-eight hours, excluding Saturdays and
    holidays, in the case of forms of proxy executed by shareholders;
    and

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} ten days, in the case of forms of proxy executed by
    policyholders.

::: HistoricalNote
- 1997, c. 15, s. 197
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Mandatory solicitation

- **[[164.03]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-164.03
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} Subject to subsections (2) and
  144(2), the management of a company shall, concurrently with sending
  notice of a meeting of shareholders and policyholders, send a form of
  proxy that is in accordance with the regulations to each shareholder
  entitled to receive notice of the meeting and to each policyholder
  entitled to receive notice of the meeting under section 143.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Exception

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} The management of a company is not required to send a
  form of proxy to shareholders under subsection (1) if the company

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} is not a distributing company; and

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} has 50 or fewer shareholders who are entitled to
    vote at a meeting, two or more joint holders of a share being
    counted as one shareholder.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Optional solicitation

  [(3)]{.lawlabel} The management of a company may send forms of proxy
  referred to in subsection (1) to policyholders who are entitled to
  vote at the meeting but not entitled to receive notice of the meeting
  under section 143, if the management

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} sends forms of proxy referred to in that subsection
    to all policyholders who are entitled to vote at the meeting but not
    entitled to receive notice of the meeting under that section; and

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} at the same time sends to each of the policyholders
    referred to in paragraph (a) a notice of the meeting as if those
    policyholders were persons entitled under that subsection to notice
    of the meeting.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Deeming rule for other provisions

  [(4)]{.lawlabel} For the purposes of this Act other than this section,
  if notices of a meeting are sent to policyholders under paragraph
  (3)(b), those policyholders are deemed to have been entitled under
  paragraph 143(1)(b) to receive notice of the meeting.

::: HistoricalNote
- 1997, c. 15, s. 197
- 2005, c. 54, s. 240
- [2022, c. 10, s. 223](#1357171-1366962){.wb-lbx
  aria-controls="centred-popup" ajax-after="1357171-1366962.html"
  role="button"}
:::

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-164.03-20061128.html "Link to previous version of section 164.03"){.PITLink}
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Soliciting proxies

- **[[164.04]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-164.04
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} A person shall not solicit proxies
  unless a proxy circular that is in accordance with the regulations is
  sent to the auditor of the company, to each shareholder or
  policyholder whose proxy is solicited and, in the case set out in
  paragraph (b), to the company as follows:

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} in the case of solicitation by or on behalf of the
    management of a company, a management proxy circular, either as an
    appendix to or as a separate document accompanying the notice of the
    meeting; and

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} in the case of any other solicitation, a
    dissident's proxy circular stating the purposes of the solicitation.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Exception --- limited solicitation

  [(1.1)]{.lawlabel} Despite subsection (1), a person may solicit
  proxies, other than by or on behalf of the management of the company,
  without sending a dissident's proxy circular, if the total number of
  shareholders and policyholders whose proxies are solicited is 15 or
  fewer, with two or more joint holders being counted as one
  shareholder.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Exception --- solicitation by public
  broadcast

  [(1.2)]{.lawlabel} Despite subsection (1), a person may solicit
  proxies, other than by or on behalf of the management of the company,
  without sending a dissident's proxy circular if the solicitation is,
  in the prescribed circumstances, conveyed by public broadcast, speech
  or publication.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Copy to Superintendent

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} A person who sends a management proxy circular or
  dissident's proxy circular shall concurrently send to the
  Superintendent a copy of it together with the form of proxy, any other
  documents for use in connection with the meeting and, in the case of a
  management proxy circular, a copy of the notice of meeting.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Exemption by Superintendent

  [(3)]{.lawlabel} On the application of an interested person, the
  Superintendent may, on any terms that the Superintendent thinks fit,
  exempt the person from any of the requirements of subsection (1) and
  section 164.03, and the exemption may be given retroactive effect.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Reporting exemptions

  [(4)]{.lawlabel} The Superintendent shall publish in a publication
  generally available to the public, a notice of a decision made by the
  Superintendent granting an exemption under subsection (3).

::: HistoricalNote
- 1997, c. 15, s. 197
- [2022, c. 10, s. 224](#1357173-1366978){.wb-lbx
  aria-controls="centred-popup" ajax-after="1357173-1366978.html"
  role="button"}
:::

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-164.04-20030101.html "Link to previous version of section 164.04"){.PITLink}
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Attendance at meeting

- **[[164.05]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-164.05
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} A person who solicits a proxy and is
  appointed proxyholder shall attend in person or cause an alternate
  proxyholder to attend every meeting in respect of which the proxy is
  valid, and the proxyholder or alternate proxyholder shall comply with
  the directions of the shareholder or policyholder who executed the
  form of proxy.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Rights of proxyholder

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} A proxyholder or an alternate proxyholder has the
  same rights as the appointing shareholder or policyholder to speak at
  a meeting of shareholders or policyholders in respect of any matter,
  to vote by way of ballot at the meeting and, except where a
  proxyholder or an alternate proxyholder has conflicting instructions
  from more than one shareholder or policyholder, to vote at the meeting
  in respect of any matter by way of a show of hands.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Vote by show of hands

  [(3)]{.lawlabel} Despite subsections (1) and (2) and unless a
  shareholder, policyholder or proxyholder demands a ballot, if the
  chairperson of a meeting of shareholders or policyholders declares to
  the meeting that, if a ballot were conducted, the total number of
  votes represented at the meeting by proxy required to be voted against
  what, to the knowledge of the chairperson, would be the decision of
  the meeting on a matter or group of matters is less than 5% of all the
  votes that might be cast by shareholders or policyholders, in person
  or by proxy,

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the chairperson may conduct the vote in respect of
    that matter or group of matters by way of a show of hands; and

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} a proxyholder or alternate proxyholder may vote in
    respect of that matter or group of matters by way of a show of
    hands.

::: HistoricalNote
- 1997, c. 15, s. 197
- 2005, c. 54, s. 242
:::

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-164.05-20030101.html "Link to previous version of section 164.05"){.PITLink}
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Duty of intermediary

- **[[164.06]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-164.06
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} Shares of a company that are
  registered in the name of an intermediary or an intermediary's nominee
  and not beneficially owned by the intermediary may not be voted unless
  the intermediary sends to the beneficial owner

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} a copy of the notice of the meeting, annual
    statement, management proxy circular and dissident's proxy circular
    and any other documents, other than the form of proxy, that were
    sent to shareholders by or on behalf of any person for use in
    connection with the meeting; and

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} a written request for voting instructions except if
    the intermediary has already received written voting instructions
    from the beneficial owner.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}When documents to be sent

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} The intermediary shall send the documents referred to
  in subsection (1) without delay after they receive the documents
  referred to in paragraph (1)(a).

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Restriction on voting

  [(3)]{.lawlabel} An intermediary or a proxyholder appointed by them
  may not vote shares that the intermediary does not beneficially own
  and that are registered in the name of the intermediary or their
  nominee unless the intermediary or proxyholder, as the case may be,
  receives written voting instructions from the beneficial owner.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Copies

  [(4)]{.lawlabel} A person by or on behalf of whom a solicitation is
  made shall on request and without delay provide the intermediary, at
  the person's expense, with the necessary number of copies of the
  documents referred to in paragraph (1)(a).

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Instructions to intermediary

  [(5)]{.lawlabel} The intermediary shall vote or appoint a proxyholder
  to vote in accordance with any written voting instructions received
  from the beneficial owner.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Beneficial owner as proxyholder

  [(6)]{.lawlabel} If a beneficial owner so requests and provides an
  intermediary with appropriate documentation, the intermediary shall
  appoint the beneficial owner or a nominee of the beneficial owner as
  proxyholder.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Effect of intermediary's failure to
  comply

  [(7)]{.lawlabel} The failure of an intermediary to comply with any of
  subsections (1) to (6) does not render void any meeting of
  shareholders or policyholders or any action taken at the meeting.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Intermediary may not vote

  [(8)]{.lawlabel} Nothing in this Division gives an intermediary the
  right to vote shares that they are otherwise prohibited from voting.

::: HistoricalNote
- 1997, c. 15, s. 197
- 2005, c. 54, s. 243
:::

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-164.06-20030101.html "Link to previous version of section 164.06"){.PITLink}
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Regulations

**[[164.061]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-164.061 .sectionLabel}** The Governor in
Council may make regulations

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} respecting the powers that may be granted by a
  shareholder or a policyholder in a form of proxy;

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} respecting proxy circulars and forms of proxy,
  including the form and content of those documents; and

- [(c)]{.lawlabel} respecting the conditions under which a company is
  exempt from any of the requirements of sections 164.01 to 164.06.

:::

[Previous
Version](section-164.061-20061128.html "Link to previous version of section 164.061"){.PITLink}
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Restraining order

- **[[164.07]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-164.07
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} If a form of proxy, management proxy
  circular or dissident's proxy circular contains an untrue statement of
  a material fact or omits to state a material fact that is required to
  be contained in it or that is necessary to make a statement contained
  in it not misleading in light of the circumstances in which the
  statement is made, an interested person or the Superintendent may
  apply to a court and the court may make any order it thinks fit
  including

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} an order restraining the solicitation or the
    holding of the meeting, or restraining any person from implementing
    or acting on a resolution passed at the meeting, to which the form
    of proxy, management proxy circular or dissident's proxy circular
    relates;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} an order requiring correction of any form of proxy
    or proxy circular and a further solicitation; and

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} an order adjourning the meeting.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Notice of application

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} Where a person other than the Superintendent is an
  applicant under subsection (1), the applicant shall give to the
  Superintendent notice of the application and the Superintendent is
  entitled to appear and to be heard in person or by counsel.

::: HistoricalNote
- 1997, c. 15, s. 197
:::

### [DIVISION I.2]{.HLabel2}[Restrictions on Voting]{.HTitleText2} {#h-259700 .Subheading}

Meaning of [[eligible votes]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

- **[[164.08]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-164.08
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} In this section, [[eligible
  votes]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means the total number of votes that may
  be cast by or on behalf of shareholders and policyholders on a vote of
  shareholders or shareholders and policyholders or a vote of holders of
  a class or series of shares, as the case may be, in respect of any
  particular matter, calculated without regard to subsection (2).

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Restriction

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} At a meeting of shareholders and policyholders of a
  company in respect of which subsection 407(4) applies or of a company
  to which subsection 407(5) applies, no person and no entity controlled
  by any person may, in respect of any vote of shareholders or
  shareholders and policyholders or holders of any class or series of
  shares of the company, cast votes in respect of any shares
  beneficially owned by the person or the entity that are, in aggregate,
  more than 20 per cent of the eligible votes that may be cast in
  respect of that vote.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Proxyholders

  [(3)]{.lawlabel} No person who is a proxyholder for a person or for an
  entity controlled by a person may cast votes to which the proxy
  relates that the person or entity may not cast by reason of subsection
  (2).

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Exception

  [(4)]{.lawlabel} Subsections (2) and (3) do not apply in respect of
  votes cast by or on behalf of

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} a company to which subsection 407(5) applies, or an
    insurance holding company to which subsection 407(6) applies, that
    controls the company; or

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} any entity that is controlled by a company or an
    insurance holding company referred to in paragraph (a).

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Exception

  [(5)]{.lawlabel} Subsections (2) and (3) do not apply in respect of a
  vote held under section 239.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Validity of vote

  [(6)]{.lawlabel} A vote in respect of a particular matter is not
  invalid merely because a person voted contrary to subsection (2) or
  (3).

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Disposition of shareholdings

  [(7)]{.lawlabel} If, with respect to any company, a person contravenes
  subsection (2) or (3), the Minister may, by order, direct the
  shareholder of the shares to which the contravention relates or any
  person controlled by that shareholder to dispose of any number of
  shares of the company beneficially owned by any of those persons that
  the Minister specifies in the order, within the time specified in the
  order and in the proportion, if any, as between the shareholder and
  the persons controlled by that shareholder that is specified in the
  order.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Restriction on voting rights

  [(8)]{.lawlabel} If the Minister makes an order under subsection (7),
  the person to whom the order relates may not, in person or by proxy,
  exercise any voting rights that are attached to shares of the company
  beneficially owned by the person.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Subsection (8) ceases to apply

  [(9)]{.lawlabel} Subsection (8) ceases to apply in respect of a person
  when the shares to which the order relates have been disposed of.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Reliance on number in notice

  [(10)]{.lawlabel} For the purpose of this section, a person is
  entitled to rely on the number of eligible votes set out in a notice
  of a meeting under subsection 143(1.01).

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Designation of persons

  [(11)]{.lawlabel} For the purpose of this section, the Minister may,
  with respect to a particular company, designate two or more persons
  who are parties to an agreement, commitment or understanding referred
  to in section 9 to be a single person.

::: HistoricalNote
- 2001, c. 9, s. 374
:::

### [DIVISION II]{.HLabel2}[Directors and Officers]{.HTitleText2} {#h-259728 .Subheading}

#### [Duties]{.HTitleText3} {#h-259729 .Subheading}

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Duty to manage

- **[[165]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-165
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} Subject to this Act, the directors
  of a company shall manage or supervise the management of the business
  and affairs of the company.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Specific duties

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} Without limiting the generality of subsection (1),
  the directors of a company shall

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} establish an audit committee to perform the duties
    referred to in subsections 203(3) and (4);

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} establish a conduct review committee to perform the
    duties referred to in subsection 204(3);

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} establish procedures to resolve conflicts of
    interest, including techniques for the identification of potential
    conflict situations and for restricting the use of confidential
    information;

  - [(d)]{.lawlabel} designate a committee of the board of directors to
    monitor the procedures referred to in paragraph (c);

  - [(e)]{.lawlabel} in the case of a company that issues participating
    policies, establish, before issuing any participating policies or,
    in the case of a former-Act company, within six months after the
    coming into force of this Part, a policy for determining the
    dividends and bonuses to be paid to the participating policyholders;

  - [(e.1)]{.lawlabel} establish a policy respecting the management of
    each of the participating accounts maintained under section 456,

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} if the company has participating policyholders on
      the day on which this paragraph comes into force, within six
      months after that day, and

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} in any other case, before issuing a
      participating policy;

  - [(e.2)]{.lawlabel} establish criteria for changes made by the
    company to the premium or charge for insurance, amount of insurance
    or surrender value in respect of its adjustable policies,

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} if the company has adjustable policyholders on
      the day on which this paragraph comes into force, within six
      months after that day, and

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} in any other case, before issuing an adjustable
      policy;

  - [(f)]{.lawlabel} establish procedures to provide disclosure of
    information to customers of the company that is required to be
    disclosed by this Act and for dealing with complaints as required by
    section 486;

  - [(g)]{.lawlabel} designate a committee of the board of directors to
    monitor the procedures referred to in paragraph (f) and satisfy
    itself that they are being adhered to by the company;

  - [(h)]{.lawlabel} establish investment and lending policies,
    standards and procedures in accordance with section 492; and

  - [(i)]{.lawlabel} in the case of a former-Act company, appoint the
    actuary of the company forthwith after the coming into force of this
    Part.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Exception

  [(3)]{.lawlabel} Paragraphs (2)(a) and (b) do not apply to the
  directors of a company where

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} all the voting shares of the company, other than
    directors' qualifying shares, if any, are beneficially owned by a
    Canadian financial institution described by any of paragraphs (a)
    to (d) of the definition [[financial
    institution]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} in subsection 2(1);

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} there are no policyholders who are entitled to
    vote; and

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} the audit committee or the conduct review committee
    of the Canadian financial institution referred to in paragraph (a)
    performs for and on behalf of the company all the functions that
    would otherwise be required to be performed by the audit committee
    or conduct review committee of the company under this Act.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Report of actuary --- par. (2)(e)

  [(3.1)]{.lawlabel} The company's actuary shall report to the directors
  in writing on the fairness to participating policyholders of any
  policy to be established or amended under paragraph (2)(e) and report
  at least once during each financial year on its continuing fairness.
  In the case of a policy established before the day on which this
  subsection comes into force, the actuary shall within six months after
  that day report on its fairness to participating policyholders and
  report at least once during each financial year on its continuing
  fairness.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Report of actuary --- par. (2)(e.1)

  [(3.2)]{.lawlabel} The company's actuary shall report to the directors
  in writing on the fairness to participating policyholders of any
  policy to be established or amended under paragraph (2)(e.1) and
  report at least once during each financial year on its continuing
  fairness.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Report of actuary --- par. (2)(e.2)

  [(3.3)]{.lawlabel} The company's actuary shall report to the directors
  in writing on the fairness to adjustable policyholders of the criteria
  to be established or amended under paragraph (2)(e.2) and report at
  least once during each financial year on their continuing fairness.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Consideration of reports

  [(3.4)]{.lawlabel} The directors shall consider the report prepared
  under subsection (3.1), (3.2) or (3.3) before establishing or amending
  a policy under paragraph (2)(e) or (e.1) or the criteria under
  paragraph (2)(e.2), as the case may be.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Generally accepted actuarial practice

  [(3.5)]{.lawlabel} The report of the actuary referred to in
  subsections (3.1) to (3.3) shall be prepared in accordance with
  generally accepted actuarial practice with such changes as may be
  determined by the Superintendent and any additional directions that
  may be made by the Superintendent.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Copy to Superintendent

  [(4)]{.lawlabel} The company shall, within 30 days after a policy is
  established or amended under paragraph (2)(e) or (e.1) or criteria are
  established or amended under paragraph (2)(e.2), send a copy to the
  Superintendent.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Access to policies

  [(4.1)]{.lawlabel} The company shall on request and free of charge
  send a copy of a policy established or amended under paragraph (2)(e)
  or (e.1) to a shareholder or participating policyholder and on payment
  of a reasonable fee to any other person.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Access to criteria

  [(4.2)]{.lawlabel} The company shall on request and free of charge
  send a copy of the criteria referred to in paragraph (2)(e.2) to an
  adjustable policyholder and on payment of a reasonable fee to any
  other person.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Regulations

  [(5)]{.lawlabel} The Governor in Council may make regulations
  respecting the content of the policies established under paragraphs
  (2)(e) and (e.1) and of the criteria established under paragraph
  (2)(e.2).

::: HistoricalNote
- 1991, c. 47, s. 165
- 1997, c. 15, s. 199
- 2001, c. 9, s. 375(F)
- 2005, c. 54, s. 244
:::

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-165-20030101.html "Link to previous version of section 165"){.PITLink}
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Duty of care

- **[[166]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-166
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} Every director and officer of a
  company in exercising any of the powers of a director or an officer
  and discharging any of the duties of a director or an officer shall

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} act honestly and in good faith with a view to the
    best interests of the company; and

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} exercise the care, diligence and skill that a
    reasonably prudent person would exercise in comparable
    circumstances.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Duty to comply

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} Every director, officer and employee of a company
  shall comply with this Act, the regulations, the company's
  incorporating instrument and the by-laws of the company.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}No exculpation

  [(3)]{.lawlabel} No provision in any contract, in any resolution or in
  the by-laws of a company relieves any director, officer or employee of
  the company from the duty to act in accordance with this Act and the
  regulations or relieves a director, officer or employee from liability
  for a breach thereof.

#### [Qualification and Number --- Directors]{.HTitleText3} {#h-259784 .Subheading}

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Minimum number of directors

- **[[167]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-167 .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} A
  company shall have at least seven directors.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Residency requirement

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} At least one half of the directors of a company that
  is a subsidiary of a foreign institution or of a prescribed holding
