#### [General Provisions]{.HTitleText3} {#h-262544 .Subheading}

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Interest of securities underwriter

**[[434]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-434 .sectionLabel}** This Part does not
apply to a securities underwriter in respect of shares of a body
corporate or ownership interests in an unincorporated entity that are
acquired by the underwriter in the course of a distribution to the
public of those shares or ownership interests and that are held by the
underwriter for a period of not more than six months.

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Arrangements to effect compliance

- **[[435]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-435 .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} The
  directors of a company may make such arrangements as they deem
  necessary to carry out the intent of this Part and, in particular, but
  without limiting the generality of the foregoing, may

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} require any person in whose name a share of the
    company is held to submit a declaration setting out

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} the beneficial ownership of the share, and

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} such other information as the directors deem
      relevant for the purposes of this Part;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} require any person who wishes to have a transfer of
    a share registered in the name of, or to have a share issued to,
    that person to submit a declaration referred to in paragraph (a) as
    though the person were the holder of that share; and

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} determine the circumstances in which a declaration
    referred to in paragraph (a) is to be required, the form of the
    declaration and the times at which it is to be submitted.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Order of Superintendent

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} The Superintendent may, by order, direct a company to
  obtain from any person in whose name a share of the company is held a
  declaration setting out the name of every entity controlled by that
  person and containing information concerning

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the ownership or beneficial ownership of the share;
    and

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} such other related matters as are specified by the
    Superintendent.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Compliance required

  [(3)]{.lawlabel} As soon as possible after receipt by a company of a
  direction under subsection (2),

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the company shall comply with the direction; and

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} every person who is requested by the company to
    provide a declaration containing information referred to in
    subsection (1) or (2) shall comply with the request.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Outstanding declaration: effect

  [(4)]{.lawlabel} Where, pursuant to this section, a declaration is
  required to be submitted by a shareholder or other person in respect
  of the issue or transfer of any share, a company may refuse to issue
  the share or register the transfer unless the required declaration is
  submitted.

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Reliance on information

**[[436]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-436 .sectionLabel}** A company and any
person who is a director or an officer, employee or agent of the company
may rely on any information contained in a declaration required by the
directors pursuant to section 435 or on any information otherwise
acquired in respect of any matter that might be the subject of such a
declaration, and no action lies against the company or any such person
for anything done or omitted to be done in good faith in reliance on any
such information.

**[[437]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-437 .sectionLabel}** [\[Repealed, 1994, c.
47, s. 128\]]{.Repealed}

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Exemption regulations

**[[438]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-438 .sectionLabel}** The Governor in Council
may, by regulation, exempt from any of the provisions of this Part any
share transaction or any class of share transactions involving the
transfer of shares on the death of the beneficial owner thereof, or any
arrangement made in contemplation of the death of the beneficial owner,
to one or more members of the beneficial owner's family, or to one or
more trustees on their behalf.

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}[Competition Act](/eng/acts/C-34)

**[[439]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-439 .sectionLabel}** Nothing in, or done
under the authority of, this Act affects the operation of the
[Competition Act](/eng/acts/C-34).

## [PART VIII]{.HLabel1}[Business and Powers]{.HTitleText1} {#h-262572 .Part}

### [General]{.HTitleText2} {#h-262573 .Subheading}

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Main business

- **[[440]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-440
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} Subject to this Act, a company shall
  not engage in or carry on any business other than such business
  generally as appertains to the business of providing financial
  services.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Idem

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} For greater certainty, a company may

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} act as a financial agent, receiver, liquidator or
    sequestrator;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} provide investment counselling services and
    portfolio management services; and

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} issue payment, credit or charge cards and, in
    cooperation with others including other financial institutions,
    operate a payment, credit or charge card plan.

::: HistoricalNote
- 1991, c. 47, s. 440
- 2009, c. 2, s. 282(F)
:::

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-440-20030101.html "Link to previous version of section 440"){.PITLink}
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Additional activities

- **[[441]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-441 .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} In
  addition, a company may

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} act as an agent for vendors, purchasers,
    mortgagors, mortgagees, lessors or lessees of real property and
    provide consulting or appraisal services in respect of real
    property;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} hold, manage and otherwise deal with real property;

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} provide information processing services in Canada
    that the company has developed for its own use and that are an
    integral part of the company's operations to entities in which the
    company has a substantial investment that do not provide information
    processing services to other entities;

  - [(d)]{.lawlabel} outside Canada, or with the prior written approval
    of the Minister, in Canada, engage in any of the following
    activities, namely,

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} collecting, manipulating and transmitting

      - [(A)]{.lawlabel} information that is primarily financial or
        economic in nature,

      - [(B)]{.lawlabel} information that relates to the business of a
        permitted entity, as defined in subsection 490(1), or

      - [(C)]{.lawlabel} any other information that the Minister may, by
        order, specify,

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} providing advisory or other services in the
      design, development or implementation of information management
      systems,

    - [(iii)]{.lawlabel} designing, developing or marketing computer
      software, and

    - [(iv)]{.lawlabel} designing, developing, manufacturing or selling,
      as an ancillary activity to any activity referred to in any of
      subparagraphs (i) to (iii) that the company is engaging in,
      computer equipment integral to the provision of information
      services related to the business of financial institutions or to
      the provision of financial services;

  - [(d.1)]{.lawlabel} with the prior written approval of the Minister,
    develop, design, hold, manage, manufacture, sell or otherwise deal
    with data transmission systems, information sites, communication
    devices or information platforms or portals that are used

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} to provide information that is primarily
      financial or economic in nature,

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} to provide information that relates to the
      business of a permitted entity, as defined in subsection 490(1),
      or

    - [(iii)]{.lawlabel} for a prescribed purpose or in prescribed
      circumstances;

  - [(e)]{.lawlabel} promote merchandise and services to the holders of
    any payment, credit or charge card issued by the company;

  - [(f)]{.lawlabel} engage in the sale of

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} tickets, including lottery tickets, on a
      non-profit public service basis in connection with special,
      temporary and infrequent non-commercial celebrations or projects
      that are of local, municipal, provincial or national interest,

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} urban transit tickets, and

    - [(iii)]{.lawlabel} tickets in respect of a lottery sponsored by
      the federal government or a provincial or municipal government or
      an agency of any such government or governments;

  - [(g)]{.lawlabel} act as a custodian of property;

  - [(h)]{.lawlabel} with the consent of the Minister

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} provide safety and risk prevention services and
      services respecting risk management and claims adjustment, where
      the provision of those services is reasonably ancillary to the
      business of insurance carried on by the company,

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} operate rehabilitation and training and
      development centres, where the operation of those centres is
      reasonably ancillary to the business of insurance carried on by
      the company,

    - [(iii)]{.lawlabel} provide computer systems to independent
      insurance brokers and agents, where the provision of those systems
      is reasonably ancillary to the business of insurance carried on by
      the company,

    - [(iv)]{.lawlabel} provide support to independent insurance brokers
      and agents, where the provision of that support is reasonably
      ancillary to the business of insurance carried on by the company,

    - [(v)]{.lawlabel} operate repair and appraisal centres, where the
      operation of those centres is reasonably ancillary to the business
      of insurance carried on by the company, and

    - [(vi)]{.lawlabel} carry on any other activities that are
      reasonably ancillary to the business of insurance carried on by
      the company; and

  - [(i)]{.lawlabel} provide identification, authentication or
    verification services.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Additional activities --- life
  companies

  [(1.1)]{.lawlabel} A life company may engage, under prescribed terms
  and conditions, if any are prescribed, in specialized business
  management or advisory services.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Terms and conditions

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} A consent given under paragraph (1)(h) is subject to
  the terms and conditions imposed by the Minister.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Restriction

  [(3)]{.lawlabel} Except as authorized by or under this Act, a company
  shall not deal in goods, wares or merchandise or engage in any trade
  or other business.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Regulations

  [(4)]{.lawlabel} The Governor in Council may make regulations

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} respecting what a company may or may not do with
    respect to the carrying on of the activities referred to in any of
    paragraphs (1)(d) and (d.1) and subsection (1.1);

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} imposing terms and conditions in respect of

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} the provision of services referred to in
      paragraphs (1)(a) and 440(2)(b), and

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} the carrying on of the activities referred to in
      any of paragraphs (1)(d) and (d.1) and subsection (1.1); and

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} respecting the circumstances in which companies may
    be exempted from the requirement to obtain the approval of the
    Minister before carrying on a particular activity referred to in
    paragraph (1)(d) or (d.1).

::: HistoricalNote
- 1991, c. 47, s. 441
- 1993, c. 34, s. 80(F)
- 1994, c. 26, s. 41(F)
- 1997, c. 15, s. 247
- 2001, c. 9, s. 416
- 2007, c. 6, s. 217(E)
- 2018, c. 12, s. 329
:::

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-441-20070420.html "Link to previous version of section 441"){.PITLink}
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Networking

- **[[442]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-442 .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} A
  company may

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} act as agent for any person in respect of the
    provision of any service that is provided by a financial
    institution, a permitted entity as defined in subsection 490(1) or a
    prescribed entity;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} enter into an arrangement with any person in
    respect of the provision of that service; or

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} refer any person to any such financial institution
    or entity.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Regulations

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} The Governor in Council may make regulations
  respecting the disclosure of

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the name of the principal for whom a company is
    acting as agent pursuant to subsection (1); and

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} whether any commission is being earned by a company
    when acting as agent pursuant to subsection (1).

::: HistoricalNote
- 1991, c. 47, s. 442
- 2001, c. 9, s. 417
:::

### [Classes of Insurance]{.HTitleText2} {#h-262643 .Subheading}

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Restriction to specified classes of
insurance

- **[[443]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-443 .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} A
  company shall not insure a risk unless the risk falls within a class
  of insurance that is specified in the order of the Superintendent
  approving the commencement and carrying on of business by the company.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Continuation of certificate limitations

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} A class of insurance specified in a certificate of
  registry, issued under Part III of the Canadian and British Insurance
  Companies Act, or in any other authorization, that had not expired or
  been withdrawn before the coming into force of this Part is deemed to
  be specified in an order of the Superintendent approving the
  commencement and carrying on of business by the company.

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Restriction to reinsurance

- **[[444]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-444 .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} A
  company may reinsure, but shall not otherwise insure, a risk falling
  within a class of insurance specified in the order of the
  Superintendent approving the commencement and carrying on of business
  by the company if the order limits the company to the reinsurance of
  those risks.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Continuation of certificate conditions

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} A condition that limits a company to the reinsurance
  of risks falling within a class of insurance and that is contained in
  a certificate of registry issued under Part III of the Canadian and
  British Insurance Companies Act, or in any other authorization, that
  had not expired or been withdrawn before the coming into force of this
  Part is deemed to be a limitation in an order of the Superintendent
  approving the commencement and carrying on of business by the company.

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}No new composite companies

**[[445]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-445 .sectionLabel}** The Superintendent may
not make or vary an order approving the commencement and carrying on of
business by a company if the company would as a result be permitted to
insure both risks falling within the class of life insurance and risks
falling within any other class of insurance other than accident and
sickness insurance, credit protection insurance and other approved
products insurance.

::: HistoricalNote
- 1991, c. 47, s. 445
- 1997, c. 15, s. 248
- 2007, c. 6, s. 218
:::

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-445-20030101.html "Link to previous version of section 445"){.PITLink}
:::

**[[446]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-446 .sectionLabel}** [\[Repealed, 2007, c.
6, s. 218\]]{.Repealed}

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-446-20030101.html "Link to previous version of section 446"){.PITLink}
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Separate accounts

**[[447]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-447 .sectionLabel}** A company that is
authorized to insure risks falling within the class of life insurance
and risks falling within one or more other classes of insurance shall
maintain separate accounts in respect of each class of insurance within
which it is authorized to insure risks.

::: HistoricalNote
- 1991, c. 47, s. 447
- 1997, c. 15, s. 249
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Annuities and endowment insurance
restricted to life companies

**[[448]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-448 .sectionLabel}** Property and casualty
companies and marine companies shall not issue annuities or policies of
endowment insurance.

::: HistoricalNote
- 1991, c. 47, s. 448
- 2007, c. 6, s. 219
:::

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-448-20030101.html "Link to previous version of section 448"){.PITLink}
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Compensation association

- **[[449]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-449
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} Every company that is insuring risks
  that fall within a class of insurance shall become and remain a member
  of any compensation association designated by order of the Minister
  for that class of insurance.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Designation limitation

  [(1.1)]{.lawlabel} A compensation association shall not be designated
  under subsection (1) unless, in the opinion of the Minister, it has
  the authority to levy an assessment on each of its members.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Exceptions

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} Subsection (1) does not apply

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} to a company that may reinsure but may not
    otherwise insure risks;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} in respect of a class of insurance that, in the
    opinion of the Minister, is adequately covered by some other
    compensation plan;

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} in respect of the insurance against the loss of, or
    damage to, property caused by fire, by lightning, by an explosion
    due to ignition, by smoke or by breakage of or leakage from a
    sprinkler, from other fire protection equipment or from another fire
    protection system by a company that is a member of the Fire Mutuals
    Guarantee Fund; or

  - [(d)]{.lawlabel} in respect of a class of insurance for which the
    Minister has not designated a compensation association.

::: HistoricalNote
- 1991, c. 47, s. 449
- 1994, c. 26, s. 42(E)
- 1996, c. 6, s. 79
- 2007, c. 6, s. 220
:::

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-449-20030101.html "Link to previous version of section 449"){.PITLink}
:::

### [Segregated Funds]{.HTitleText2} {#h-262680 .Subheading}

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Segregated funds restricted to life
companies

**[[450]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-450 .sectionLabel}** A property and casualty
company, or a marine company, shall not issue policies --- or accept or
retain, on the direction of a policyholder or beneficiary, policy
dividends or bonuses, or policy proceeds that are payable on the
surrender or maturity of the policy or on the death of the person whose
life is insured --- if the liabilities of the company in respect of the
policies or the amounts accepted or retained vary in amount depending on
the market value of a fund consisting of a specified group of assets.

::: HistoricalNote
- 1991, c. 47, s. 450
- 2007, c. 6, s. 221
:::

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-450-20030101.html "Link to previous version of section 450"){.PITLink}
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Where segregated funds required

**[[451]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-451 .sectionLabel}** A life company that
issues policies described in section 450 or accepts or retains amounts
so described shall, in respect of those policies or amounts,

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} maintain separate accounts; and

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} establish and maintain one or more funds consisting
  of assets that are segregated from the other assets of the company and
  that are specified as the assets on the market value of which the
  liabilities of the company in respect of those policies or amounts
  depend.

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Establishment and maintenance of
segregated funds

**[[452]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-452 .sectionLabel}** For the purpose of
establishing or maintaining a segregated fund required to be established
and maintained by section 451, a company may, subject to the regulations
and, in the case of a transfer from a participating account maintained
pursuant to section 456, to section 463, transfer an amount to the
separate account maintained in respect of the segregated fund.

::: HistoricalNote
- 1991, c. 47, s. 452
- 1994, c. 26, s. 43
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Transfers from segregated funds

**[[453]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-453 .sectionLabel}** A company may return
the current value of an amount transferred under section 452 to the
account from which the amount was transferred.

::: HistoricalNote
- 1991, c. 47, s. 453
- 2007, c. 6, s. 222
:::

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-453-20030101.html "Link to previous version of section 453"){.PITLink}
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Claims against segregated funds

**[[454]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-454 .sectionLabel}** A claim against a
segregated fund maintained as required by section 451 under a policy or
for an amount in respect of which the fund is maintained has priority
over any other claim against the assets of that fund, including the
claims referred to in section 161 of the [Winding-up and Restructuring
Act](/eng/acts/W-11), except to the extent that the payment of that
other claim is secured by a security interest in or on a specific,
identifiable asset of the segregated fund.

::: HistoricalNote
- 1991, c. 47, s. 454
- 1996, c. 6, s. 167
- 1997, c. 15, s. 250
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Restriction of claims

**[[455]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-455 .sectionLabel}** The liability of a
company under a policy or for an amount in respect of which a segregated
fund is maintained pursuant to section 451

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} does not, except to the extent that the assets of the
  fund are insufficient to satisfy a claim for any minimum amount that
  the company agrees to pay under the policy or in respect of the
  amount, give rise to a claim against any assets of the company, other
  than the assets of that fund,

but

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} to the extent that the assets of the fund are
  insufficient to satisfy such a claim, gives rise to a claim against
  the assets of the company, other than the assets of that fund, that
  has the priority referred to in subsection 161(2) of the [Winding-up
  and Restructuring Act](/eng/acts/W-11).

::: HistoricalNote
- 1991, c. 47, s. 455
- 1996, c. 6, s. 167
:::

### [Participating Policies]{.HTitleText2} {#h-262708 .Subheading}

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Participating account

**[[456]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-456 .sectionLabel}** A company shall
maintain accounts, in the form and manner determined by the
Superintendent, in respect of participating policies, separately from
those maintained in respect of other policies.

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Allocation of income

**[[457]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-457 .sectionLabel}** There shall be credited
to, or debited from, a participating account maintained pursuant to
section 456 that portion of the investment income or losses of the
company for a financial year, including accrued capital gains or losses,
whether or not realized, that is determined in accordance with a method
that is

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} in the written opinion of the actuary of the company,
  fair and equitable to the participating policyholders;

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} approved by resolution of the directors, after
  considering the written opinion of the actuary of the company; and

- [(c)]{.lawlabel} not disallowed by the Superintendent, on the ground
  that it is not fair and equitable to the participating policyholders,
  within sixty days after receiving the resolution.

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Allocation of expenses

**[[458]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-458 .sectionLabel}** There shall be debited
from a participating account maintained pursuant to section 456 that
portion of the expenses, including taxes, of the company for a financial
year that is determined in accordance with a method that is

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} in the written opinion of the actuary of the company,
  fair and equitable to the participating policyholders;

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} approved by resolution of the directors, after
  considering the written opinion of the actuary of the company; and

- [(c)]{.lawlabel} not disallowed by the Superintendent, on the ground
  that it is not fair and equitable to the participating policyholders,
  within sixty days after receiving the resolution.

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Filing of allocation method

**[[459]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-459 .sectionLabel}** A company the directors
of which by resolution approve a method of allocating its investment
income and losses and expenses to a participating account maintained
pursuant to section 456 shall, within thirty days after making the
resolution, file a copy of it with the Superintendent, together with a
copy of the written opinion of the actuary of the company and any other
information relevant to the allocation method that the Superintendent
requests.

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Review of allocation method

**[[460]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-460 .sectionLabel}** The actuary of a
company shall annually report in writing to the directors on the
fairness and equitableness of the method used by the company for
allocating its investment income and losses and expenses to a
participating account maintained pursuant to section 456.

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Payments to shareholders from
participating account

**[[461]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-461 .sectionLabel}** A company that has
share capital may, from a participating account maintained pursuant to
section 456, in a financial year and at any time within six months after
the end of that financial year, make a payment to its shareholders, or
transfer an amount to an account (other than a participating shareholder
account as defined in section 83.01) from which a payment can be made to
its shareholders, if

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} the aggregate of the amounts so paid or transferred
  in that financial year does not exceed the percentage of the portion
  of the profits of the participating account that is determined by the
  directors as the portion to be distributed for that financial year to
  the shareholders and participating policyholders, which percentage
  shall not exceed the number, expressed as a percentage, that is the
  aggregate of

  - [(i)]{.lawlabel} 10 multiplied by the lesser of

    - [(A)]{.lawlabel} the sum of the opening balances for that
      financial year of all participating accounts of the company, and

    - [(B)]{.lawlabel} two hundred and fifty million dollars,

  - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} 7.5 multiplied by the amount, if any, by which the
    lesser of

    - [(A)]{.lawlabel} the sum of the opening balances for that
      financial year of all participating accounts of the company, and

    - [(B)]{.lawlabel} five hundred million dollars

    exceeds two hundred and fifty million dollars,

  - [(iii)]{.lawlabel} 5 multiplied by the amount, if any, by which the
    lesser of

    - [(A)]{.lawlabel} the sum of the opening balances for that
      financial year of all participating accounts of the company, and

    - [(B)]{.lawlabel} one billion dollars

    exceeds five hundred million dollars, and

  - [(iv)]{.lawlabel} 2.5 multiplied by the amount, if any, by which the
    sum of the opening balances for that financial year of all
    participating accounts of the company exceeds one billion dollars,

  divided by the sum of the opening balances for that financial year of
  all the participating accounts;

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} the company pays dividends or bonuses to its
  participating policyholders out of the profits of the participating
  account for that financial year in accordance with its dividend or
  bonus policy established pursuant to paragraph 165(2)(e); and

- [(c)]{.lawlabel} the payment to the shareholders, or the transfer to
  the account from which a payment can be made to the shareholders,
  would not, in the opinion of the actuary of the company, materially
  affect the company's ability to continue to comply with its dividend
  or bonus policy or to maintain the levels or rates of dividends or
  bonuses paid to the company's participating policyholders.

::: HistoricalNote
- 1991, c. 47, s. 461
- 1997, c. 15, s. 251
- 2007, c. 6, s. 223
:::

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-461-20030101.html "Link to previous version of section 461"){.PITLink}
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Transfers from participating account

**[[462]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-462 .sectionLabel}** The only transfers that
may be made from a participating account maintained pursuant to section
456 are

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} transfers made pursuant to sections 461 and 463;

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} transfers made in respect of transfers or reinsurance
  of all or any portion of the participating policies in respect of
  which the participating account is maintained;

- [(c)]{.lawlabel} transfers, with the approval of the Superintendent,
  of amounts that can be reasonably attributed to sources not related to
  the participating policies in respect of which the account is or has
  been maintained, if the transfer would not, in the opinion of the
  actuary of the company, materially affect the company's ability to
  continue to comply with its dividend or bonus policy, maintain the
  levels or rates of dividends or bonuses paid to the company's
  participating policyholders or meet the company's obligations under
  its participating policies; and

- [(d)]{.lawlabel} transfers made in respect of the conversion of a
  mutual company into a company with common shares.

::: HistoricalNote
- 1991, c. 47, s. 462
- 1997, c. 15, s. 252
- 1999, c. 1, s. 8
- 2007, c. 6, s. 224
:::

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-462-20030101.html "Link to previous version of section 462"){.PITLink}
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Transfers to segregated funds from
participating account

- **[[463]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-463 .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} A
  company may transfer from a participating account maintained pursuant
  to section 456 to a segregated fund maintained pursuant to section 451
  an amount not exceeding the amount determined in accordance with the
  formula

  ::: {#262756 .Subsection}
  A - (B - C)

  where

  [A]{.dfn}
  :   is 25 per cent of the unappropriated earned surplus of that
      account;

  [B]{.dfn}
  :   is the aggregate amount of all previous transfers from that
      account to the segregated funds; and

  [C]{.dfn}
  :   is the aggregate amount returned to the participating account from
      the segregated funds.
  :::

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Ceiling

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} The aggregate amount of all transfers from
  participating accounts maintained pursuant to section 456 to the
  segregated funds maintained pursuant to section 451 may not exceed the
  amount determined in accordance with the formula

  ::: {#262763 .Subsection}
  A - (B - C)

  where

  [A]{.dfn}
  :   is 10 per cent of the aggregate unappropriated earned surplus of
      the participating accounts;

  [B]{.dfn}
  :   is the aggregate amount of all previous transfers from those
      accounts to those funds; and

  [C]{.dfn}
  :   is the aggregate amount returned to those accounts from those
      funds.
  :::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Declaration of policy dividend or bonus

- **[[464]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-464
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} Subject to this section, the
  directors of a company that issues participating policies may declare,
  and the company may pay or otherwise satisfy, a dividend, bonus or
  other benefit on those policies in accordance with its dividend or
  bonus policy established pursuant to paragraph 165(2)(e).

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Report of actuary

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} The company's actuary shall, in writing, report to
  the directors on the fairness to participating policyholders of a
  proposed dividend, bonus or other benefit and whether it is in
  accordance with the policy. The directors shall consider the actuary's
  report before declaring the dividend, bonus or other benefit.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Generally accepted actuarial practice

  [(2.1)]{.lawlabel} The report of the actuary referred to in
  subsection (2) shall be prepared in accordance with generally accepted
  actuarial practice with such changes as may be determined by the
  Superintendent and any additional directions that may be made by the
  Superintendent.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}When dividend not to be declared

  [(3)]{.lawlabel} The directors of a company shall not declare a
  dividend, bonus or other benefit to participating policyholders if
  there are reasonable grounds for believing that the company is, or the
  payment or other satisfaction would cause the company to be, in
  contravention of subsection 515(1), any regulation made under
  subsection 515(2) or any order made under subsection 515(3).

::: HistoricalNote
- 1991, c. 47, s. 464
- 2005, c. 54, s. 296
- 2007, c. 6, s. 225
:::

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-464-20070420.html "Link to previous version of section 464"){.PITLink}
:::

### [Adjustable Policies]{.HTitleText2} {#h-262779 .Subheading}

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Report of actuary

- **[[464.1]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-464.1
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} The actuary of a company that has
  adjustable policyholders shall, annually and in writing, report to the
  directors on whether the changes that the company made in respect of
  its adjustable policies during the preceding 12 months are in
  accordance with the criteria established under paragraph 165(2)(e.2)
  and are fair to the adjustable policyholders.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Generally accepted actuarial practice

  [(1.1)]{.lawlabel} The report of the actuary referred to in
  subsection (1) shall be prepared in accordance with generally accepted
  actuarial practice with such changes as may be determined by the
  Superintendent and any additional directions that may be made by the
  Superintendent.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Information to policyholder

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} A company that made changes in respect of its
  adjustable policies during the preceding 12 months shall within the
  prescribed period send the prescribed information to the policyholder,
  if the adjustable policy was issued in Canada or if it confers voting
  rights.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Information to policyholder --- renewal

  [(3)]{.lawlabel} In the case of the renewal of an adjustable policy,
  the company shall within the prescribed period send the prescribed
  information to the policyholder.

::: HistoricalNote
- 2005, c. 54, s. 297
- 2012, c. 5, s. 130
:::

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-464.1-20110601.html "Link to previous version of section 464.1"){.PITLink}
:::

### [Reinsurance]{.HTitleText2} {#h-262791 .Subheading}

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Regulations

- **[[465]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-465 .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} The
  Governor in Council may make regulations limiting the extent to which
  a company may cause itself to be reinsured against risks undertaken
  under its policies.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Regulation may provide for discretion

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} A regulation made pursuant to subsection (1) may
  provide that the Superintendent may, by order, determine the matters
  or exercise the discretion that the regulation may specify.

::: HistoricalNote
- 1991, c. 47, s. 465
- 2007, c. 6, s. 226
:::

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-465-20030101.html "Link to previous version of section 465"){.PITLink}
:::

### [Restrictions]{.HTitleText2} {#h-262799 .Subheading}

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Restriction on fiduciary activities

**[[466]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-466 .sectionLabel}** No company shall act in
Canada as

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} an executor, administrator or official guardian or a
  guardian, tutor, curator, judicial adviser or committee of a mentally
  incompetent person; or

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} a trustee for a trust.

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Restriction on deposit taking

**[[467]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-467 .sectionLabel}** Except as otherwise
permitted by this Act, a company shall not accept deposits.

::: HistoricalNote
- 1991, c. 47, s. 467
- 1999, c. 31, s. 143(F)
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Restriction on securities activities

**[[468]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-468 .sectionLabel}** A company shall not
deal in Canada in securities to the extent prohibited or restricted by
such regulations as the Governor in Council may make for the purposes of
this section.

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Prohibition

- **[[468.1]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-468.1
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} It is prohibited for a company to
  issue a debt obligation in relation to which the amounts of principal
  and interest owing are guaranteed to be paid from loans or other
  assets held by an entity that is created and organized for the
  principal purpose of holding those loans or other assets and with the
  intention of legally isolating those loans or other assets from the
  company, unless

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the debt obligation is a covered bond as defined in
    section 21.5 of the [National Housing Act](/eng/acts/N-11);

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} the company is a registered issuer as defined in
    section 21.5 of that Act other than one whose right to issue covered
    bonds has been suspended; and

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} the debt obligation is issued under a registered
    program as defined in section 21.5 of that Act.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Exception

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} The Governor in Council may make regulations
  exempting any type of debt obligation from the application of
  subsection (1).

::: HistoricalNote
- 2012, c. 19, s. 363
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Restriction on residential mortgages

- **[[469]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-469 .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} A
  company shall not make a loan in Canada on the security of residential
  property in Canada for the purpose of purchasing, renovating or
  improving that property, or refinance such a loan, if the amount of
  the loan, together with the amount then outstanding of any mortgage
  having an equal or prior claim against the property, would exceed 80
  per cent of the value of the property at the time of the loan.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Exception

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} Subsection (1) does not apply in respect of

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} a loan made or guaranteed under the [National
    Housing Act](/eng/acts/N-11) or any other Act of Parliament by or
    pursuant to which a different limit on the value of property on the
    security of which the company may make a loan is established;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} a loan if repayment of the amount of the loan that
    exceeds the maximum amount set out in subsection (1) is guaranteed
    or insured by a government agency or a private insurer approved by
    the Superintendent;

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} the acquisition by the company from an entity of
    securities issued or guaranteed by the entity that are secured on
    any residential property, whether in favour of a trustee or
    otherwise, or the making of a loan by the company to the entity
    against the issue of such securities; or

  - [(d)]{.lawlabel} a loan secured by a mortgage where

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} the mortgage is taken back by the company on a
      property disposed of by the company, including where the
      disposition is by way of a realization of a security interest, and

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} the mortgage secures payment of an amount
      payable to the company for the property.

::: HistoricalNote
- 1991, c. 47, s. 469
- 1997, c. 15, s. 253
- 2007, c. 6, s. 227
:::

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-469-20030101.html "Link to previous version of section 469"){.PITLink}
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Restriction on charges to borrowers

- **[[469.1]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-469.1
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} Subject to any regulations made
  under subsection (2), a company that has obtained insurance or a
  guarantee against default on a loan made in Canada on the security of
  residential property shall not charge a borrower an amount for the
  insurance or guarantee that exceeds the actual cost to the company of
  the insurance or guarantee.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Regulations

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} The Governor in Council may make regulations

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} respecting the determination of the actual cost to
    a company for the purposes of subsection (1);

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} respecting the circumstances in which a company is
    exempt from the application of subsection (1);

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} respecting, in relation to insurance or a guarantee
    against default on a loan made by a company in Canada on the
    security of residential property,

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} the arrangements into which the company, its
      representatives and its employees may or may not enter, and

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} the payments or benefits that the company, its
      representatives and its employees may or may not accept from an
      insurer or the insurer's affiliates; and

  - [(d)]{.lawlabel} respecting any other matters necessary to carry out
    the purposes of subsection (1).

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Regulations --- disclosure

  [(3)]{.lawlabel} The Governor in Council may make regulations
  respecting the disclosure by a company of information relating to
  insurance or a guarantee against default on a loan made by the company
  in Canada on the security of residential property, including
  regulations respecting

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the information that must be disclosed, including
    information relating to

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} the person who benefits from the insurance or
      guarantee,

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} the arrangements between the company, its
      representatives or its employees and the insurer or the insurer's
      affiliates, and

    - [(iii)]{.lawlabel} the payments and benefits that the company, its
      representatives and its employees accept from an insurer or the
      insurer's affiliates;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} the time and place at which, the form and manner in
    which and the persons to whom information is to be disclosed; and

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} the circumstances under which a company is not
    required to disclose information.

::: HistoricalNote
- 2009, c. 2, s. 283
- 2012, c. 5, s. 131(E)
:::

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-469.1-20100701.html "Link to previous version of section 469.1"){.PITLink}
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Policies re security interests

- **[[470]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-470 .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} The
  directors of a company shall establish and the company shall adhere to
  policies regarding the creation of security interests in property of
  the company to secure obligations of the company and the acquisition
  by the company of beneficial interests in property that is subject to
  security interests.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Order to amend policies

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} The Superintendent may, by order, direct a company to
  amend its policies as specified in the order.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Compliance

  [(3)]{.lawlabel} A company shall comply with an order made under
  subsection (2) within the time specified in the order.

::: HistoricalNote
- 1991, c. 47, s. 470
- 2001, c. 9, s. 418
:::

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-470-20030101.html "Link to previous version of section 470"){.PITLink}
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Regulations and guidelines

**[[470.1]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-470.1 .sectionLabel}** The Governor in
Council may make regulations and the Superintendent may make guidelines
respecting the creation by a company of security interests in its
property to secure obligations of the company and the acquisition by the
company of beneficial interests in property that is subject to security
interests.

::: HistoricalNote
- 2001, c. 9, s. 418
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Exception

**[[470.2]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-470.2 .sectionLabel}** Sections 470 and
470.1 do not apply in respect of a security interest created by a
company to secure an obligation of the company to the Bank of Canada.

::: HistoricalNote
- 2001, c. 9, s. 418
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Restriction on receivers

**[[471]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-471 .sectionLabel}** A company shall not
grant to a person the right to appoint a receiver or a receiver and
manager of the property or business of the company.

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Restriction on partnerships

- **[[472]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-472
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} Except with the approval of the
  Superintendent, a company may not be a general partner in a limited
  partnership or a partner in a general partnership.

- Meaning of [[general partnership]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} For the purposes of subsection (1), [[general
  partnership]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means any partnership other than a
  limited partnership.

::: HistoricalNote
- 1991, c. 47, s. 472
- 2001, c. 9, s. 419
:::

### [Restrictions Specific to Life Companies]{.HTitleText2} {#h-262880 .Subheading}

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}General restriction

- **[[473]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-473 .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} A
  life company shall not, and shall not permit its prescribed
  subsidiaries to, enter into any debt obligation, within the meaning
  assigned to that expression by the regulations, or issue any share,
  other than a common share, if as a result the aggregate of the total
  debt obligations of the company, determined in the prescribed manner,
  and the stated capital of the company would exceed the prescribed
  percentage of the total assets of the company.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Exception

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} A life company need not include in the aggregate
  amount calculated for the purposes of subsection (1) the value of any
  debt obligation or the stated capital of any shares if the value of
  the debt obligation or the stated capital of the shares is included as
  part of the regulatory capital of the company.

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Restriction on guarantees

- **[[474]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-474 .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} A
  life company shall not guarantee on behalf of any person the payment
  or repayment of any sum of money unless

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the sum of money is a fixed sum of money with or
    without interest thereon; and

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} the person on whose behalf the company has
    undertaken to guarantee the payment or repayment has an unqualified
    obligation to reimburse the company for the full amount of the
    payment or repayment to be guaranteed.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Exception

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} Paragraph (1)(a) does not apply where the person on
  whose behalf the company has undertaken to guarantee a payment or
  repayment is a subsidiary of the company.

- [(3)]{.lawlabel} [\[Repealed, 1997, c. 15, s. 254\]]{.Repealed}

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Regulations

  [(4)]{.lawlabel} The Governor in Council may make regulations imposing
  terms and conditions in respect of guarantees permitted by this
  section.

::: HistoricalNote
- 1991, c. 47, s. 474
- 1997, c. 15, s. 254
- 2001, c. 9, s. 420
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Restriction on leasing

**[[475]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-475 .sectionLabel}** A life company shall
not engage in Canada in any personal property leasing activity in which
a financial leasing entity, within the meaning of subsection 490(1), is
not permitted to engage.

::: HistoricalNote
- 1991, c. 47, s. 475
- 2001, c. 9, s. 421
:::

### [Restrictions Specific to Property and Casualty Companies and Marine Companies]{.HTitleText2} {#h-262902 .Subheading}

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}General restriction

- **[[476]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-476 .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} A
  property and casualty company, or a marine company, shall not, and
  shall not permit its prescribed subsidiaries to, enter into any debt
  obligation, within the meaning assigned to that expression by the
  regulations, or issue any share, other than a common share, if as a
  result the aggregate of the total debt obligations of the company,
  determined in the prescribed manner, and the stated capital of the
  company would exceed the prescribed percentage of the total assets of
  the company.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Exception

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} A property and casualty company, or a marine company,
  need not include in the aggregate amount calculated for the purposes
  of subsection (1) the value of any debt obligation if the value of the
  debt obligation is included as part of the regulatory capital of the
  company.

::: HistoricalNote
- 1991, c. 47, s. 476
- 2007, c. 6, s. 228
- [2022, c. 10, s. 233](#1357222-1388283){.wb-lbx
  aria-controls="centred-popup" ajax-after="1357222-1388283.html"
  role="button"}
:::

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-476-20070420.html "Link to previous version of section 476"){.PITLink}
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Restriction on guarantees

- **[[477]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-477 .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} A
  property and casualty company, or a marine company, shall not
  guarantee on behalf of any person the payment or repayment of any sum
  of money unless the person on whose behalf the company has undertaken
  to guarantee the payment or repayment is a subsidiary of the company
  and has an unqualified obligation to reimburse the company for the
  full amount of the payment or repayment to be guaranteed.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Saving

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} Subsection (1) does not prevent a property and
  casualty company, or a marine company, from insuring a risk falling
  within a class of insurance that is specified in the order of the
  Superintendent approving the commencement and carrying on of business
  by the company.

::: HistoricalNote
- 1991, c. 47, s. 477
- 1997, c. 15, s. 255
- 2001, c. 9, s. 422
- 2007, c. 6, s. 228
:::

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-477-20030101.html "Link to previous version of section 477"){.PITLink}
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Restriction on leasing

**[[478]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-478 .sectionLabel}** A property and casualty
company, or a marine company, shall not engage in Canada in any
financial leasing of personal property.

::: HistoricalNote
- 1991, c. 47, s. 478
- 2007, c. 6, s. 228
:::

### [Borrowing Costs]{.HTitleText2} {#h-262918 .Subheading}

Definition of [[cost of borrowing]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}

**[[479]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-479 .sectionLabel}** For the purposes of
this section and sections 479.1 to 487, [[cost of
borrowing]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} means, in respect of a loan or an
advance on the security or against the cash surrender value of a policy
made by a company,

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} the interest or discount applicable to the loan or
  advance;

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} any amount charged in connection with the loan or
  advance that is payable by the borrower to the company; and

- [(c)]{.lawlabel} any charge prescribed to be included in the cost of
  borrowing.

For those purposes, however, [[cost of borrowing]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}
does not include any charge prescribed to be excluded from the cost of
borrowing.

::: HistoricalNote
- 1991, c. 47, s. 479
- 1997, c. 15, s. 256
- 2001, c. 9, s. 423
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Rebate of borrowing costs

- **[[479.1]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-479.1
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} Where a company makes a loan in
  respect of which the disclosure requirements of section 480 apply and
  the loan is not secured by a mortgage on real property and is required
  to be repaid either on a fixed future date or by instalments, the
  company shall, if there is a prepayment of the loan, rebate to the
  borrower a portion of the charges included in the cost of borrowing in
  respect of the loan.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Exception

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} The charges to be rebated do not include the interest
  or discount applicable to the loan.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Regulations

  [(3)]{.lawlabel} The Governor in Council may make regulations
  governing the rebate of charges under subsection (1). The rebate shall
  be made in accordance with those regulations.

::: HistoricalNote
- 1997, c. 15, s. 256
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Disclosing borrowing costs --- loans

- **[[480]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-480 .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} A
  company shall not make a loan to a natural person that is repayable in
  Canada unless the cost of borrowing, as calculated and expressed in
  accordance with section 481, and other prescribed information have
  been disclosed by the company to the borrower at the prescribed time
  and place and in the prescribed form and manner.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Non-application

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} Subsection (1) does not apply in respect of a loan
  that is of a prescribed class of loans.

::: HistoricalNote
- 1991, c. 47, s. 480
- 1997, c. 15, s. 256
- 2012, c. 5, s. 132
:::

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-480-20030101.html "Link to previous version of section 480"){.PITLink}
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Calculating borrowing costs

**[[481]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-481 .sectionLabel}** The cost of borrowing
shall be calculated, in the prescribed manner, on the basis that all
obligations of the borrower are duly fulfilled and shall be expressed as
a rate per annum and, in prescribed circumstances, as an amount in
dollars and cents.

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Additional disclosure

- **[[482]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-482
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} Where a company makes a loan in
  respect of which the disclosure requirements of section 480 are
  applicable and the loan is required to be repaid either on a fixed
  future date or by instalments, the company shall disclose to the
  borrower, in accordance with the regulations,

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} whether the borrower has the right to repay the
    amount borrowed before the maturity of the loan and, if applicable,

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} any terms and conditions relating to that right,
      including the particulars of the circumstances in which the
      borrower may exercise that right, and

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} whether, in the event that the borrower
      exercises the right, any portion of the cost of borrowing is to be
      rebated, the manner in which any such rebate is to be calculated
      or, if a charge or penalty will be imposed on the borrower, the
      manner in which the charge or penalty is to be calculated;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} in the event that an amount borrowed is not repaid
    at maturity or, if applicable, an instalment is not paid on the day
    the instalment is due to be paid, particulars of the charges or
    penalties to be paid by the borrower because of the failure to repay
    or pay in accordance with the contract governing the loan;

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} at the prescribed time and place and in the
    prescribed form and manner, any prescribed changes respecting the
    cost of borrowing or the loan agreement;

  - [(d)]{.lawlabel} particulars of any other rights and obligations of
    the borrower; and

  - [(e)]{.lawlabel} any other prescribed information, at the prescribed
    time and place and in the prescribed form and manner.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Disclosure in credit card applications

  [(1.1)]{.lawlabel} A company shall, in accordance with the
  regulations, at the prescribed time and place and in the prescribed
  form and manner, provide prescribed information in any application
  forms or related documents that it prepares for the issuance of
  credit, payment or charge cards and provide prescribed information to
  any person applying to it for a credit, payment or charge card.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Disclosure re credit cards

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} Where a company issues or has issued a credit,
  payment or charge card to a natural person, the company shall, in
  addition to disclosing the costs of borrowing in respect of any loan
  obtained through the use of the card, disclose to the person, in
  accordance with the regulations,

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} any charges or penalties described in paragraph
    (1)(b);

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} particulars of the person's rights and obligations;

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} any charges for which the person becomes
    responsible by accepting or using the card;

  - [(d)]{.lawlabel} at the prescribed time and place and in the
    prescribed form and manner, any prescribed changes respecting the
    cost of borrowing or the loan agreement; and

  - [(e)]{.lawlabel} any other prescribed information, at the prescribed
    time and place and in the prescribed form and manner.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Additional disclosure re other loans

  [(3)]{.lawlabel} Where a company enters into or has entered into an
  arrangement, including a line of credit, for the making of a loan in
  respect of which the disclosure requirements of section 480 apply and
  the loan is not a loan in respect of which subsection (1) or (2)
  applies, the company shall, in addition to disclosing the costs of
  borrowing, disclose to the person to whom the loan is made, in
  accordance with the regulations,

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} any charges or penalties described in paragraph
    (1)(b);

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} particulars of the person's rights and obligations;

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} any charges for which the person is responsible
    under the arrangement;

  - [(d)]{.lawlabel} at the prescribed time and place and in the
    prescribed form and manner, any prescribed changes respecting the
    cost of borrowing under the arrangement; and

  - [(e)]{.lawlabel} any other prescribed information, at the prescribed
    time and place and in the prescribed form and manner.

::: HistoricalNote
- 1991, c. 47, s. 482
- 1997, c. 15, s. 257
- 2012, c. 5, s. 133
:::

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-482-20030101.html "Link to previous version of section 482"){.PITLink}
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Renewal statement

**[[482.1]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-482.1 .sectionLabel}** If a company makes
a loan in respect of which the disclosure requirements of section 480
apply and the loan is secured by a mortgage on real property, the
company shall disclose to the borrower, at the prescribed time and place
and in the prescribed form and manner, any information that is
prescribed respecting the renewal of the loan.

::: HistoricalNote
- 1997, c. 15, s. 258
- 2012, c. 5, s. 134
:::

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-482.1-20030101.html "Link to previous version of section 482.1"){.PITLink}
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Disclosure in advertising

**[[483]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-483 .sectionLabel}** No person shall
authorize the publication, issue or appearance of any advertisement in
Canada relating to arrangements referred to in subsection 482(3), loans,
credit cards, payment cards or charge cards, offered to natural persons
by a company, and purporting to disclose prescribed information about
the cost of borrowing or about any other matter unless the advertisement
discloses prescribed information at the prescribed time and place and in
the prescribed form and manner.

::: HistoricalNote
- 1991, c. 47, s. 483
- 1997, c. 15, s. 258
- 2012, c. 5, s. 134
:::

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-483-20030101.html "Link to previous version of section 483"){.PITLink}
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Disclosing borrowing costs --- advances

**[[484]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-484 .sectionLabel}** If regulations have
been made respecting the manner in which the cost of borrowing is to be
disclosed in respect of an advance on the security or against the cash
surrender value of a policy, a company shall not make such an advance
unless the cost of borrowing, as calculated and expressed in accordance
with the regulations, has, at the prescribed time and place and in the
prescribed form and manner, been disclosed by the company or otherwise
as prescribed to the policyholder at or before the time when the advance
is made.

::: HistoricalNote
- 1991, c. 47, s. 484
- 2007, c. 6, s. 229(E)
- 2012, c. 5, s. 134
:::

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-484-20070420.html "Link to previous version of section 484"){.PITLink}
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Regulations re borrowing costs

**[[485]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-485 .sectionLabel}** The Governor in Council
may make regulations

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} respecting the time and place at which, and the form
  and manner in which, a company is to disclose to a borrower

  - [(i)]{.lawlabel} the cost of borrowing,

  - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} any rebate of the cost of borrowing, and

  - [(iii)]{.lawlabel} any other information relating to a loan,
    arrangement, credit card, payment card or charge card referred to in
    section 482;

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} respecting the contents of any statement disclosing
  the cost of borrowing and other information required to be disclosed
  by a company to a borrower;

- [(c)]{.lawlabel} respecting the manner of calculating the cost of
  borrowing;

- [(d)]{.lawlabel} respecting the circumstances under which the cost of
  borrowing is to be expressed as an amount in dollars and cents;

- [(e)]{.lawlabel} specifying any class of loans that are not to be
  subject to section 479.1 or subsection 480(1) or 482(1) or (3) or
  section 482.1 or 483 or the regulations or any specified provisions of
  the regulations;

- [(f)]{.lawlabel} specifying any class of advances that are not to be
  subject to section 484 or the regulations or any specified provisions
  of the regulations;

- [(g)]{.lawlabel} respecting the time and place at which, and the form
  and manner in which, any rights, obligations, charges or penalties
  referred to in sections 479.1 to 484 are to be disclosed;

- [(h)]{.lawlabel} prohibiting the imposition of any charge or penalty
  referred to in section 482 or providing that the charge or penalty, if
  imposed, will not exceed a prescribed amount;

- [(i)]{.lawlabel} respecting the nature or amount of any charge or
  penalty referred to in paragraph 482(1)(b), (2)(a) or (3)(a) and the
  costs of the company that may be included or excluded in the
  determination of the charge or penalty;

- [(j)]{.lawlabel} respecting the method of calculating the amount of
  rebate of the cost of borrowing, or the portion of the cost of
  borrowing referred to in subparagraph 482(1)(a)(ii);

- [(k)]{.lawlabel} respecting advertisements made by a company regarding
  arrangements referred to in subsection 482(3), loans, credit cards,
  payment cards or charge cards;

- [(l)]{.lawlabel} respecting the renewal of loans; and

- [(m)]{.lawlabel} respecting such other matters or things as are
  necessary to carry out the purposes of sections 479.1 to 484.

::: HistoricalNote
- 1991, c. 47, s. 485
- 1997, c. 15, s. 259
- 2012, c. 5, s. 135
:::
