Version](section-542.06-20030101.html "Link to previous version of section 542.06"){.PITLink}
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Restriction on charges to borrowers

- **[[542.061]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-542.061
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} Subject to any regulations made
  under subsection (2), a society that has obtained insurance or a
  guarantee against default on a loan made in Canada on the security of
  residential property shall not charge a borrower an amount for the
  insurance or guarantee that exceeds the actual cost to the society of
  the insurance or guarantee.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Regulations

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} The Governor in Council may make regulations

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} respecting the determination of the actual cost to
    a society for the purposes of subsection (1);

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} respecting the circumstances in which a society is
    exempt from the application of subsection (1);

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} respecting, in relation to insurance or a guarantee
    against default on a loan made by a society in Canada on the
    security of residential property,

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} the arrangements into which the society, its
      representatives and its employees may or may not enter, and

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} the payments or benefits that the society, its
      representatives and its employees may or may not accept from an
      insurer or the insurer's affiliates; and

  - [(d)]{.lawlabel} respecting any other matters necessary to carry out
    the purposes of subsection (1).

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Regulations --- disclosure

  [(3)]{.lawlabel} The Governor in Council may make regulations
  respecting the disclosure by a society of information relating to
  insurance or a guarantee against default on a loan made by the society
  in Canada on the security of residential property, including
  regulations respecting

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the information that must be disclosed, including
    information relating to

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} the person who benefits from the insurance or
      guarantee,

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} the arrangements between the society, its
      representatives or its employees and the insurer or the insurer's
      affiliates, and

    - [(iii)]{.lawlabel} the payments and benefits that the society, its
      representatives and its employees accept from an insurer or the
      insurer's affiliates;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} the time and place at which, the form and manner in
    which and the persons to whom information is to be disclosed; and

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} the circumstances under which a society is not
    required to disclose information.

::: HistoricalNote
- 2009, c. 2, s. 285
- 2012, c. 5, s. 141(E)
:::

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-542.061-20100701.html "Link to previous version of section 542.061"){.PITLink}
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Policies re security interests

- **[[542.07]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-542.07
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} The directors of a society shall
  establish and the society shall adhere to policies regarding the
  creation of security interests in property of the society to secure
  obligations of the society and the acquisition by the society of
  beneficial interests in property that is subject to security
  interests.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Order to amend policies

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} The Superintendent may, by order, direct a society to
  amend its policies as specified in the order.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Compliance

  [(3)]{.lawlabel} A society shall comply with an order made under
  subsection (2) within the time specified in the order.

::: HistoricalNote
- 1997, c. 15, s. 285
- 2001, c. 9, s. 433
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Regulations and guidelines

**[[542.071]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-542.071 .sectionLabel}** The Governor in
Council may make regulations and the Superintendent may make guidelines
respecting the creation by a society of security interests in its
property to secure obligations of the society and the acquisition by the
society of beneficial interests in property that is subject to security
interests.

::: HistoricalNote
- 2001, c. 9, s. 433
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Restriction on receivers

**[[542.08]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-542.08 .sectionLabel}** A society shall
not grant to a person the right to appoint a receiver or a receiver and
manager of the property or business of the society.

::: HistoricalNote
- 1997, c. 15, s. 285
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Restriction on partnerships

**[[542.09]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-542.09 .sectionLabel}** Except with the
approval of the Superintendent, a society may not be a general partner
in a limited partnership or a partner in any partnership other than a
limited partnership.

::: HistoricalNote
- 1997, c. 15, s. 285
- 2001, c. 9, s. 434
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}General restriction

- **[[542.1]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-542.1
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} A society shall not, and shall not
  permit its prescribed subsidiaries to, enter into any debt obligation,
  within the meaning assigned to that expression by the regulations, or
  permit its prescribed subsidiaries to issue any share, other than a
  common share, if as a result the aggregate of the total debt
  obligations of the society, determined in the prescribed manner, and
  the stated capital of the society would exceed the prescribed
  percentage of the total assets of the society.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Exception

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} A society need not include in the aggregate amount
  calculated for the purpose of subsection (1) the value of any debt
  obligation or the stated capital of any shares if the value of the
  debt obligation or the stated capital of the shares is included as
  part of the regulatory capital of the society.

::: HistoricalNote
- 1997, c. 15, s. 285
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Restriction on guarantees

- **[[542.11]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-542.11
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} A society shall not guarantee on
  behalf of any person the payment or repayment of any sum of money
  unless

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the sum of money is a fixed sum of money with or
    without interest on it; and

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} the person on whose behalf the society has
    undertaken to guarantee the payment or repayment has an unqualified
    obligation to reimburse the society for the full amount of the
    payment or repayment to be guaranteed.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Exception

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} Paragraph (1)(a) does not apply where the person on
  whose behalf the society has undertaken to guarantee a payment or
  repayment is a subsidiary of the society.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Regulations

  [(3)]{.lawlabel} The Governor in Council may make regulations imposing
  terms and conditions in respect of guarantees permitted by this
  section.

::: HistoricalNote
- 1997, c. 15, s. 285
- 2001, c. 9, s. 435
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Prepayment protected

- **[[542.12]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-542.12
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} A society shall not make a loan to a
  natural person if the loan would be repayable in Canada and the terms
  would prohibit prepayment of the money advanced or any instalment of
  that money before its due date.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Non-application of subsection (1)

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} Subsection (1) does not apply in respect of a loan

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} that is secured by a mortgage on real property; or

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} that is made for business purposes and the
    principal amount of which is more than \$100,000 or such other
    amount as may be prescribed.

::: HistoricalNote
- 1997, c. 15, s. 285
:::

### [Corporate Governance]{.HTitleText2} {#h-264117 .Subheading}

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Majority to reside in Canada

**[[543]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-543 .sectionLabel}** A majority of the
members of the supreme governing body of every society shall at the time
of their election or appointment be individuals who are resident in
Canada.

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Head office

- **[[544]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-544 .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} A
  society shall at all times have a head office in the province
  specified in its incorporating instrument or by-laws.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Change of head office --- different
  province

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} Despite anything contained in its incorporating
  instrument, any society may, by by-law passed and approved by the
  votes of at least two thirds of the members entitled to vote by the
  by-laws of the society who are present or represented at a special
  meeting duly called for considering the by-law, change the head office
  of the society from one province to another.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Change of head office --- within a
  province

  [(2.1)]{.lawlabel} The supreme governing body of a society may, by
  resolution passed and approved by at least two thirds of the votes
  cast at a meeting, change the address of the head office within the
  province specified in the society's by-laws.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Notice of change of address

  [(2.2)]{.lawlabel} If there is a change of address of the head office
  of a society, the society shall send a notice of the change to the
  Superintendent within fifteen days after the change.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Maximum period

  [(3)]{.lawlabel} A society shall establish by by-law the maximum
  period of time within which meetings of the society shall be held.

::: HistoricalNote
- 1991, c. 47, s. 544
- 1997, c. 15, s. 286
- 2005, c. 54, s. 298
:::

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-544-20030101.html "Link to previous version of section 544"){.PITLink}
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Change of name

- **[[544.1]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-544.1
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} Despite anything contained in its
  incorporating instrument, a society may, by by-law passed and approved
  by the votes of at least two thirds of the members entitled to vote by
  the by-laws of the society who are present or represented at a special
  meeting duly called for considering the by-law, change the name of the
  society.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Effective date

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} A by-law referred to in subsection (1) is not
  effective until the Superintendent approves it.

::: HistoricalNote
- 2001, c. 9, s. 436
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Appointing proxyholder

- **[[545]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-545 .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} A
  member who is entitled to vote by by-law of a society may, if the
  by-laws of the society so provide, by executing an instrument of
  proxy, appoint a proxyholder or one or more alternate proxyholders,
  who are not required to be members of the society, to attend and act
  at the meeting in the manner and to the extent authorized by the proxy
  and with the authority conferred by the proxy.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Validity of proxies

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} An instrument of proxy is not valid at a meeting of a
  society unless it is filed with the secretary of the society at least
  ten days before the date of the meeting and it may be revoked at any
  time.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Societies to inform members of rights

  [(3)]{.lawlabel} A society for which an order approving the
  commencement and carrying on of business of life insurance has been
  made under this Act that has members who are entitled to vote at
  meetings of the society shall advise each of those members at least
  once a year by means of a statement printed in prominent type on a
  premium notice, premium receipt or dividend notice or otherwise, of
  the rights of the member to attend and to vote in person or by proxy
  at those meetings and to obtain a blank instrument of proxy on request
  therefor in writing to the secretary of the society, but in the case
  of a member who is not in receipt of a regular annual premium notice
  from the society, notice of the rights of the member to attend and to
  vote at meetings of the society may be given only at least once every
  five years.

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Valuation balance sheet to be sent to
members

**[[546]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-546 .sectionLabel}** Every society for which
an order approving the commencement and carrying on of business has been
made under this Act shall, not later than June 1 in each year, mail to
each member of the society a copy of the valuation balance sheet in the
prescribed form and an explanation of the facts concerning the condition
of the society or, in lieu thereof, shall publish in its official paper
that balance sheet and explanation and mail a copy of the issue of the
paper containing the balance sheet and explanation to each of the
society's members.

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Auditors and actuaries

- **[[547]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-547
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} Divisions XIII and XIV of Part VI
  apply to societies with such modifications as the circumstances
  require.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Appointment of actuary

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} The directors of a former-Act society shall,
  forthwith after the coming into force of this Part, appoint the
  actuary of the society.

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}By-laws

- **[[548]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-548
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} Unless this Act otherwise provides,
  the supreme governing body of a society may by resolution make, amend
  or repeal any by-law that regulates the business or affairs of the
  society.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Deemed by-laws

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} Any matter provided for in the incorporating
  instrument of a former-Act society on the coming into force of this
  Part that, under this Act, would be provided for in the by-laws of a
  society is deemed to be provided for in the by-laws of the society.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Copies to Superintendent

  [(3)]{.lawlabel} Within thirty days after a by-law of a society comes
  into effect or is amended, the society shall send a copy of the by-law
  or the amendment to the Superintendent. A society shall send to the
  Superintendent, within six months after the coming into force of this
  subsection, its by-laws that are in effect on the coming into force of
  this subsection.

::: HistoricalNote
- 1991, c. 47, s. 548
- 1997, c. 15, s. 287
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Return

- **[[549]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-549
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} Every society shall, each year
  before June 30 of that year, provide the Superintendent with a return
  showing

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the name, residence and citizenship of each
    director of the society;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} the mailing address of each director;

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} the bodies corporate of which each director
    referred to in paragraph (a) is an officer or director and the firms
    of which each director is a member;

  - [(d)]{.lawlabel} the names of the directors referred to in
    paragraph (a) who are officers or employees of the society, and the
    positions they occupy;

  - [(e)]{.lawlabel} the date of expiration of the term of each director
    referred to in paragraph (a); and

  - [(f)]{.lawlabel} the name, address and date of appointment of the
    auditor of the society.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Information

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} Where

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} any information relating to a director or auditor
    of a society shown in the latest return made to the Superintendent
    under subsection (1), other than information referred to in
    paragraph (1)(c), becomes inaccurate or incomplete,

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} a vacancy in the position of auditor of the society
    occurs or is filled by another person, or

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} a vacancy on the supreme governing body of the
    society occurs or is filled,

  the society shall forthwith provide the Superintendent with such
  information as is required to maintain the return in a complete and
  accurate form.

::: HistoricalNote
- 1991, c. 47, s. 549
- 1997, c. 15, s. 288
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Sections 261, 262 and 266 to 270 apply

- **[[549.1]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-549.1
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} Sections 261, 262 and 266 to 270
  apply to societies, with the modifications that the circumstances
  require.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}For greater certainty

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} For greater certainty, subsection 262(3.1) does not
  apply to societies.

::: HistoricalNote
- 2012, c. 5, s. 142
- [2020, c. 1, s. 176](#1238257-1311963){.wb-lbx
  aria-controls="centred-popup" ajax-after="1238257-1311963.html"
  role="button"}
:::

### [Investments]{.HTitleText2} {#h-264184 .Subheading}

#### [Application]{.HTitleText3} {#h-264185 .Subheading}

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Non-application of sections 551 to 570

**[[550]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-550 .sectionLabel}** Sections 551 to 570 do
not apply in respect of

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} any interest in real property arising through the
  holding of a security interest in real property;

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} any interest in an entity arising through the holding
  of a security interest in securities of that entity; or

- [(c)]{.lawlabel} assets of a segregated fund maintained as required by
  subsection 542.03(2).

::: HistoricalNote
- 1991, c. 47, s. 550
- 1997, c. 15, s. 289
:::

#### [General Constraints on Investments]{.HTitleText3} {#h-264193 .Subheading}

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Investment standards

**[[551]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-551 .sectionLabel}** The directors of a
society shall establish and the society shall adhere to investment and
lending policies, standards and procedures that a reasonable and prudent
person would apply in respect of a portfolio of investments and loans to
avoid undue risk of loss and obtain a reasonable return.

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Limit --- business growth fund

- **[[551.1]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-551.1
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} The aggregate value of all ownership
  interests in the business growth fund and the entities that the
  business growth fund controls that a society and its subsidiaries hold
  must not exceed \$200,000,000.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Application

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} For the purposes of subsection (1), the value of an
  ownership interest is determined by the amount paid for it at the time
  of its issuance.

::: HistoricalNote
- 2018, c. 27, s. 148
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Restriction on control and substantial
investments

- **[[552]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-552
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} Subject to subsections (2) to (3.4),
  no society shall acquire control of, or hold, acquire or increase a
  substantial investment in, any entity other than a permitted entity.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Exception: indirect investments

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} A society may acquire control of, or acquire or
  increase a substantial investment in, an entity other than a permitted
  entity by way of

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} an acquisition of control of an entity referred to
    in any of paragraphs 554(1)(a) to (c), or of a prescribed entity,
    that controls or has a substantial investment in the entity; or

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} an acquisition of shares or ownership interests in
    the entity by

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} an entity referred to in any of paragraphs
      554(1)(a) to (c), or a prescribed entity, that is controlled by
      the society, or

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} an entity controlled by an entity referred to in
      any of paragraphs 554(1)(a) to (c), or a prescribed entity, that
      is controlled by the society.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Exception: temporary investments,
  realizations and loan workouts

  [(3)]{.lawlabel} A society may acquire control of, or acquire or
  increase a substantial investment in, an entity by way of

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} a temporary investment permitted by section 557;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} an acquisition of shares of a body corporate or of
    ownership interests in an unincorporated entity permitted by section
    558; or

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} a realization of security permitted by section 559.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Business growth fund

  [(3.1)]{.lawlabel} Subject to section 551.1 and subsections (3.2) to
  (3.4), a society may hold, acquire or increase a substantial
  investment in the business growth fund or any entity that the business
  growth fund controls.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}For greater certainty

  [(3.2)]{.lawlabel} For greater certainty, a society is prohibited from
  acquiring control of the business growth fund or any entity that the
  business growth fund controls.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Prohibition --- entity

  [(3.3)]{.lawlabel} A society is prohibited from holding or acquiring a
  substantial investment in the business growth fund or any entity that
  the business growth fund controls if the business growth fund or any
  entity that the business growth fund controls holds or acquires shares
  of, or other ownership interests in, any of the following entities, or
  in any entity that controls any of the following entities:

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} an entity referred to in any of paragraphs
    495(1)(a) to (j);

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} an entity that is primarily engaged in the leasing
    of motor vehicles in Canada for the purpose of extending credit to a
    customer or financing a customer's acquisition of a motor vehicle;

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} an entity that is primarily engaged in providing
    temporary possession of personal property, including motor vehicles,
    to customers in Canada for a purpose other than to finance the
    customer's acquisition of the property;

  - [(d)]{.lawlabel} an entity that acts as an insurance broker or agent
    in Canada; or

  - [(e)]{.lawlabel} an entity that is engaged in any prescribed
    activity.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Prohibition --- capital and loans

  [(3.4)]{.lawlabel} A society is prohibited from holding or acquiring a
  substantial investment in the business growth fund or any entity that
  the business growth fund controls if the business growth fund or any
  entity that the business growth fund controls holds shares of, or
  other ownership interests in, an entity or holds a loan made to an
  entity and, in respect of that entity and its affiliates, the
  aggregate value of the following exceeds \$100,000,000:

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} all ownership interests that are held by the
    society, the society's subsidiaries, the business growth fund or the
    entities that the business growth fund controls, the value of those
    ownership interests as determined by the amount paid for them at the
    time each was first acquired by any of those entities; and

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} the outstanding principal of all loans held by the
    business growth fund or the entities that the business growth fund
    controls.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Exception: uncontrolled event

  [(4)]{.lawlabel} A society is deemed not to contravene subsection (1)
  if the society acquires control of, or acquires or increases a
  substantial investment in, an entity solely as the result of an event
  not within the control of the society.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Non-application of subsection (2)

  [(4.1)]{.lawlabel} No society shall, under subsection (2), acquire
  control of, or acquire or increase a substantial investment in, an
  entity referred to in paragraph 554(1)(c).

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Holding

  [(4.2)]{.lawlabel} If a society holds a substantial investment in an
  entity referred to in paragraph 554(1)(c) that it acquired or
  increased under subsection (2) before the coming into force of
  subsection (4.1), the society may continue to hold that substantial
  investment.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Application of other provision

  [(5)]{.lawlabel} Despite having acquired control of, or a substantial
  investment in, an entity under a particular provision of this Part, a
  society may continue to control the entity or hold the substantial
  investment in the entity as though it had made the acquisition under
  another provision of this Part so long as the conditions of that other
  provision are met.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Timing of deemed acquisition

  [(6)]{.lawlabel} If a society decides to exercise its right under
  subsection (5), the society is deemed to be acquiring the control or
  the substantial investment under the other provision.

::: HistoricalNote
- 1991, c. 47, s. 552
- 1997, c. 15, s. 290
- 1999, c. 31, s. 144
- 2001, c. 9, s. 437
- 2007, c. 6, s. 252
- 2013, c. 40, s. 171
- 2018, c. 27, s. 149
:::

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-552-20131212.html "Link to previous version of section 552"){.PITLink}
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Regulations re limits

**[[553]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-553 .sectionLabel}** The Governor in Council
may make regulations

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} respecting the determination of the amount or value
  of loans, investments and interests for the purposes of sections 550
  to 570;

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} respecting the loans and investments, and the maximum
  aggregate amount of all loans and investments, that may be made or
  acquired by a society and its prescribed subsidiaries to or in a
  person and any persons connected with that person; and

- [(c)]{.lawlabel} specifying the classes of persons who are connected
  with any person for the purposes of paragraph (b).

::: HistoricalNote
- 1991, c. 47, s. 553
- 2001, c. 9, s. 437
:::

#### [Subsidiaries and Equity Investments]{.HTitleText3} {#h-264251 .Subheading}

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Permitted investments

- **[[554]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-554
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} Subject to subsections (4) and (5),
  a society may acquire control of, or acquire or increase a substantial
  investment in,

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} a company or a society;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} an insurance corporation incorporated or formed by
    or under an Act of the legislature of a province; or

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} an entity that is incorporated or formed, and
    regulated, otherwise than by or under an Act of Parliament or of the
    legislature of a province and that is primarily engaged outside
    Canada in a business that, if carried on in Canada, would be the
    business of insurance.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Permitted investments

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} Subject to subsections (3) to (5), a society may
  acquire control of, or acquire or increase a substantial investment
  in, an entity, other than an entity referred to in any of paragraphs
  (1)(a) to (c), whose business is limited to one or more of the
  following:

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} engaging in any financial service activity or in
    any other activity that a property and casualty company is permitted
    to engage in under subsection 440(2) or section 441 or 442, other
    than paragraph 441(1)(h);

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} acquiring or holding shares of, or ownership
    interests in, entities in which a society is permitted under this
    Part to hold or acquire;

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} engaging in the provision of any services
    exclusively to any or all of the following, so long as the entity is
    providing those services to the society or any member of the
    society's group:

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} the society,

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} any member of the society's group,

    - [(iii)]{.lawlabel} any entity that is primarily engaged in the
      business of providing financial services,

    - [(iv)]{.lawlabel} any permitted entity in which an entity referred
      to in subparagraph (iii) has a substantial investment, or

    - [(v)]{.lawlabel} any prescribed person, if it is doing so under
      prescribed terms and conditions, if any are prescribed;

  - [(d)]{.lawlabel} engaging in any activity that a society is
    permitted to engage in, other than an activity referred to in
    paragraph (a) or (e), that relates to

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} the promotion, sale, delivery or distribution of
      a financial product or financial service that is provided by the
      society or any member of the society's group, or

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} if a significant portion of the business of the
      entity involves an activity referred to in subparagraph (i), the
      promotion, sale, delivery or distribution of a financial product
      or financial service that is provided by any other entity that is
      primarily engaged in the business of providing financial services;

  - [(e)]{.lawlabel} engaging in the activities referred to in the
    definition [[closed-end fund]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm}, [[mutual fund
    distribution entity]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} or [[mutual fund
    entity]{.dfn}]{.DefinedTerm} in subsection 490(1); and

  - [(f)]{.lawlabel} engaging in prescribed activities, under prescribed
    terms and conditions, if any are prescribed.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Permitted infrastructure entities

  [(2.1)]{.lawlabel} Subject to subsection (3), a society may --- under
  any prescribed terms and conditions --- acquire control of, or acquire
  or increase a substantial investment in, a permitted infrastructure
  entity.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Restriction

  [(3)]{.lawlabel} A society may not acquire control of, or acquire or
  increase a substantial investment in, an entity whose business
  includes any activity referred to in any of paragraphs (2)(a) to (e),
  or in any regulation made under paragraph 2.2(b), if the entity
  engages in the business of accepting deposit liabilities or if the
  activities of the entity include

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} activities that a property and casualty company is
    not permitted to engage in under any of sections 466, 469 and 478;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} any financial intermediary activity that exposes
    the entity to material market or credit risk, including the
    activities of a finance entity, a factoring entity and a financial
    leasing entity;

  - [(b.1)]{.lawlabel} the activities of a specialized financing entity;

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} dealing in securities, except as may be permitted
    under paragraph (2)(e) or as may be permitted to a company under
    paragraph 440(2)(b);

  - [(d)]{.lawlabel} acquiring control of or acquiring or holding a
    substantial investment in another entity unless

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} in the case of an entity, other than a permitted
      infrastructure entity, that is controlled by the society, the
      society itself would be permitted under this Part to acquire a
      substantial investment in the other entity,

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} in the case of an entity, other than a permitted
      infrastructure entity, that is not controlled by the society, the
      society itself would be permitted to acquire a substantial
      investment in the other entity under subsection (1), (2) or (2.1)
      or 552(2) or paragraph 552(3)(b) or (c), or

    - [(iii)]{.lawlabel} in the case of a permitted infrastructure
      entity, whether or not that entity is controlled by the society,
      the society itself would be permitted to acquire a substantial
      investment in the other entity under subsection (2.1); or

  - [(e)]{.lawlabel} any prescribed activity.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Exception

  [(3.1)]{.lawlabel} Despite paragraph (3)(a), a society may acquire
  control of, or acquire or increase a substantial investment in, any
  entity that acts as a trustee of a trust if the entity has been
  authorized under the laws of a province to act as a trustee of a trust
  and the entity is

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} a closed-end fund;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} a mutual fund entity; or

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} an entity whose business is limited to engaging in
    one or more of the following:

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} the activities of a mutual fund distribution
      entity,

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} any activity that a company is permitted to
      engage in under subsection 441(1.1), and

    - [(iii)]{.lawlabel} the provision of investment counselling
      services and portfolio management services.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Control

  [(4)]{.lawlabel} Subject to subsection (6) and the regulations, a
  society may not acquire control of, or acquire or increase a
  substantial investment in,

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} an entity referred to in any of paragraphs (1)(a)
    to (c), unless the society controls, within the meaning of paragraph
    3(1)(d), the entity, or would thereby acquire control, within the
    meaning of that paragraph, of the entity; or

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} an entity whose business includes an activity
    referred to in paragraph (2)(b), unless

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} the society controls, within the meaning of
      paragraph 3(1)(d), the entity, or

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} subject to prescribed terms and conditions, if
      any are prescribed, the activities of the entity do not include
      the acquisition or holding of control of, or the acquisition or
      holding of shares or other ownership interests in, an entity
      referred to in paragraph (a) or an entity that is not a permitted
      entity.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Minister's approval

  [(5)]{.lawlabel} Subject to the regulations, a society may not,
  without the prior written approval of the Minister, acquire control
  of, or acquire or increase a substantial investment in, a permitted
  entity other than a permitted infrastructure entity or an entity whose
  activities are limited to acquiring or holding shares of, or ownership
  interests in, permitted infrastructure entities.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Control not required

  [(6)]{.lawlabel} A society need not control an entity referred to in
  paragraph (1)(c), or an entity that is incorporated or formed
  otherwise than by or under an Act of Parliament or of the legislature
  of a province, if the laws or customary business practices of the
  country under the laws of which the entity was incorporated or formed
  do not permit the society to control the entity.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Prohibition on giving up control in
  fact

  [(7)]{.lawlabel} A society that, under subsection (4), controls an
  entity may not, without the prior written approval of the Minister,
  give up control, within the meaning of paragraph 3(1)(d), of the
  entity while it continues to control the entity.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Subsections do not apply

  [(8)]{.lawlabel} If a society controls, within the meaning of
  paragraph 3(1)(a), (b) or (c), an entity, subsection (5) does not
  apply in respect of any subsequent increases by the society to its
  substantial investment in the entity so long as the society continues
  to control the entity.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Regulations

  [(9)]{.lawlabel} The Governor in Council may make regulations

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} for the purposes of subsection (4), permitting the
    acquisition of control or the acquisition or increase of substantial
    investments, or prescribing the circumstances under which that
    subsection does not apply or the societies or other entities in
    respect of which that subsection does not apply, including
    prescribing societies or other entities on the basis of the
    activities they engage in;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} for the purposes of subsection (5), permitting the
    acquisition of control or the acquisition or increase of substantial
    investments, or prescribing the circumstances under which that
    subsection does not apply or the societies or other entities in
    respect of which that subsection does not apply, including
    prescribing societies or other entities on the basis of the
    activities they engage in; and

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} for the purposes of subsection (2.1), establishing
    terms and conditions respecting the acquisition of control of, or
    the acquisition or increase of a substantial investment in, a
    permitted infrastructure entity by a society.

::: HistoricalNote
- 1991, c. 47, s. 554
- 1997, c. 15, s. 291
- 2001, c. 9, s. 437
- 2007, c. 6, ss. 253, 336(F)
- [2018, c. 12, s. 346](#1038691-1423854){.wb-lbx
  aria-controls="centred-popup" ajax-after="1038691-1423854.html"
  role="button"}
:::

[Previous
Version](section-554-20070420.html "Link to previous version of section 554"){.PITLink}
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Approval for indirect investments

**[[555]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-555 .sectionLabel}** If a society obtains
the approval of the Minister under subsection 554(5) to acquire control
of, or to acquire or increase a substantial investment in, an entity
and, through that acquisition or increase, the society indirectly
acquires control of, or acquires or increases a substantial investment
in, another entity that would require the approval of the Minister under
subsection 554(5) and that indirect acquisition or increase is disclosed
to the Minister in writing before the approval is obtained, the society
is deemed to have obtained the approval of the Minister for that
indirect acquisition or increase.

::: HistoricalNote
- 1991, c. 47, s. 555
- 2001, c. 9, s. 437
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Undertakings

- **[[556]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-556 .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} If a
  society controls a permitted entity, other than an entity referred to
  in any of paragraphs 554(1)(a) to (c), the society shall provide the
  Superintendent with any undertakings that the Superintendent may
  require regarding

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the activities of the entity; and

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} access to information about the entity.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Undertakings

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} If a society acquires control of an entity referred
  to in paragraph 554(1)(b) or (c), the society shall provide the
  Superintendent with any undertakings concerning the entity that the
  Superintendent may require.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Agreements with other jurisdictions

  [(3)]{.lawlabel} The Superintendent may enter into an agreement with
  the appropriate official or public body responsible for the
  supervision of any entity referred to in paragraph 554(1)(b) or (c) in
  each province or in any other jurisdiction concerning any matters
  referred to in paragraphs (1)(a) and (b) or any other matter the
  Superintendent considers appropriate.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Access to records

  [(4)]{.lawlabel} Despite any other provision of this Part, a society
  shall not control a permitted entity, other than an entity referred to
  in paragraph 554(1)(a), unless, in the course of the acquisition of
  control or within a reasonable time after the control is acquired, the
  society obtains from the permitted entity an undertaking to provide
  the Superintendent with reasonable access to the records of the
  permitted entity.

::: HistoricalNote
- 1991, c. 47, s. 556
- 2001, c. 9, s. 437
:::

#### [Exceptions and Exclusions]{.HTitleText3} {#h-264328 .Subheading}

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Temporary investments in entity

- **[[557]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-557
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} Subject to subsection (4), a society
  may, by way of a temporary investment, acquire control of, or acquire
  or increase a substantial investment in, an entity but, within two
  years, or any other period that may be specified or approved by the
  Superintendent, after acquiring control or after acquiring or
  increasing the substantial investment, as the case may be, it shall do
  all things necessary to ensure that it no longer controls the entity
  or has a substantial investment in the entity.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Transitional

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} Despite subsection (1), if a society that was in
  existence immediately before June 1, 1992 had an investment in an
  entity on September 27, 1990 that is a substantial investment within
  the meaning of section 10 and the society subsequently increases that
  substantial investment by way of a temporary investment, the society
  shall, within two years, or any other period that is specified or
  approved by the Superintendent, after increasing the substantial
  investment, do all things necessary to ensure that its substantial
  investment in the entity is no greater than it was on September 27,
  1990.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Extension

  [(3)]{.lawlabel} The Superintendent may, in the case of any particular
  society that makes an application under this subsection, extend the
  period of two years, or the other period specified or approved by the
  Superintendent, that is referred to in subsection (1) or (2) for any
  further period or periods, and on any terms and conditions, that the
  Superintendent considers necessary.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Temporary investment

  [(4)]{.lawlabel} If a society, by way of temporary investment,
  acquires control of, or acquires or increases a substantial investment
  in, an entity for which the approval of the Minister would have been
  required under subsection 554(5) if the society had acquired the
  control, or acquired or increased the substantial investment, under
  section 554, the society must, within 90 days after acquiring control
  or after acquiring or increasing the substantial investment,

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} apply to the Minister for approval to retain
    control of the entity or to continue to hold the substantial
    investment in the entity for a period specified by the Minister or
    for an indeterminate period on any terms and conditions that the
    Minister considers appropriate; or

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} do all things necessary to ensure that, on the
    expiry of the 90 days, it no longer controls the entity or does not
    have a substantial investment in the entity.

::: HistoricalNote
- 1991, c. 47, s. 557
- 2001, c. 9, s. 437
- 2007, c. 6, s. 254
:::

::: PITLink
[Previous
Version](section-557-20030101.html "Link to previous version of section 557"){.PITLink}
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Loan workouts

- **[[558]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-558
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} Despite anything in this Part, if a
  society or any of its subsidiaries has made a loan to an entity and,
  under the terms of the agreement between the society, or any of its
  subsidiaries, and the entity with respect to the loan and any other
  documents governing the terms of the loan, a default has occurred, the
  society may acquire

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} if the entity is a body corporate, all or any of
    the shares of the body corporate;

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} if the entity is an unincorporated entity, all or
    any of the ownership interests in the entity;

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} all or any of the shares or all or any of the
    ownership interests in any entity that is an affiliate of the
    entity; or

  - [(d)]{.lawlabel} all or any of the shares of a body corporate that
    is primarily engaged in holding shares of, ownership interests in or
    assets acquired from the entity or any of its affiliates.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Obligation

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} If a society acquires shares or ownership interests
  in an entity under subsection (1), the society shall, within five
  years after acquiring them, do all things necessary to ensure that the
  society does not control the entity or have a substantial investment
  in the entity.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Transitional

  [(3)]{.lawlabel} Despite subsection (1), if a society that was in
  existence immediately before June 1, 1992 had an investment in an
  entity on September 27, 1990 that is a substantial investment within
  the meaning of section 10 and the society later increases that
  substantial investment by way of an investment made under subsection
  (1), the society shall, within five years after increasing the
  substantial investment, do all things necessary to ensure that its
  substantial investment in the entity is no greater than it was on
  September 27, 1990.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Extension

  [(4)]{.lawlabel} The Superintendent may, in the case of any particular
  society that makes an application under this subsection, extend the
  period of five years referred to in subsection (2) or (3) for any
  further period or periods, and on any terms and conditions, that the
  Superintendent considers necessary.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Exception --- entities controlled by
  foreign governments

  [(5)]{.lawlabel} Despite anything in this Part, if a society has made
  a loan to, or holds a debt obligation of, the government of a foreign
  country or an entity controlled by the government of a foreign country
  and, under the terms of the agreement between the society and that
  government or the entity, as the case may be, and any other documents
  governing the terms of the loan or debt obligation, a default has
  occurred, the society may acquire all or any of the shares of, or
  ownership interests in, that entity or in any other entity designated
  by that government, if the acquisition is part of a debt restructuring
  program of that government.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Time for holding shares

  [(6)]{.lawlabel} If a society acquires any shares or ownership
  interests under subsection (5), the society may, on any terms and
  conditions that the Superintendent considers appropriate, hold those
  shares or ownership interests for an indeterminate period or for any
  other period that the Superintendent may specify.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Exception

  [(7)]{.lawlabel} If, under subsection (1), a society acquires control
  of, or acquires or increases a substantial investment in, an entity
  that it would otherwise be permitted to acquire or increase under
  section 554, the society may retain control of the entity or continue
  to hold the substantial investment for an indeterminate period, if the
  approval in writing of the Minister is obtained before the end of the
  period referred to in subsection (2) or (3), including any extension
  of it granted under subsection (4).

::: HistoricalNote
- 1991, c. 47, s. 558
- 1997, c. 15, s. 292
- 2001, c. 9, s. 437
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Realizations

- **[[559]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-559
  .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} Despite anything in this Act, a
  society may acquire

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} an investment in a body corporate,

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} an interest in an unincorporated entity, or

  - [(c)]{.lawlabel} an interest in real property,

  if the investment or interest is acquired through the realization of a
  security interest held by the society or any of its subsidiaries.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Disposition

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} If a society acquires control of, or acquires a
  substantial investment in, an entity by way of the realization of a
  security interest held by the society or any of its subsidiaries, the
  society shall, within five years after the day on which control or the
  substantial investment is acquired, do all things necessary, or cause
  its subsidiary to do all things necessary, as the case may be, to
  ensure that the society no longer controls the entity or has a
  substantial investment in the entity.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Transitional

  [(3)]{.lawlabel} Despite subsection (2), if a society that was in
  existence immediately before June 1, 1992 had an investment in an
  entity on September 27, 1990 that is a substantial investment within
  the meaning of section 10 and the society later increases that
  substantial investment by way of a realization of a security interest
  under subsection (1), the society shall, within five years after
  increasing the substantial investment, do all things necessary to
  ensure that its substantial investment in the entity is no greater
  than it was on September 27, 1990.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Extension

  [(4)]{.lawlabel} The Superintendent may, in the case of any particular
  society that makes an application under this subsection, extend the
  period of five years referred to in subsection (2) or (3) for any
  further period or periods, and on any terms and conditions, that the
  Superintendent considers necessary.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Exception

  [(5)]{.lawlabel} If, under subsection (1), a society acquires control
  of, or acquires or increases a substantial investment in, an entity
  that it would otherwise be permitted to acquire or increase under
  section 554, the society may retain control of the entity or continue
  to hold the substantial investment for an indeterminate period if the
  approval in writing of the Minister is obtained before the end of the
  period referred to in subsection (2) or (3), including any extension
  of it granted under subsection (4).

::: HistoricalNote
- 1991, c. 47, s. 559
- 1997, c. 15, s. 293
- 2001, c. 9, s. 437
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Regulations restricting ownership

**[[560]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-560 .sectionLabel}** The Governor in Council
may make regulations restricting the ownership under sections 554 to 559
by a society of shares of a body corporate or of ownership interest in
an unincorporated entity and imposing terms and conditions applicable to
societies that own such shares or interests.

::: HistoricalNote
- 1991, c. 47, s. 560
- 2001, c. 9, s. 437
:::

#### [Portfolio Limits]{.HTitleText3} {#h-264384 .Subheading}

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Exclusion from portfolio limits

- **[[561]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-561 .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} The
  value of all loans, investments and interests acquired by a society
  and any of its prescribed subsidiaries as a result of a realization of
  a security interest or pursuant to section 558 shall not be included
  in calculating the value of loans, investments and interests of the
  society and its prescribed subsidiaries under sections 562 to 566

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} for a period of twelve years following the day on
    which the interest was acquired, in the case of an interest in real
    property; and

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} for a period of five years after the day on which
    the loan, investment or interest was acquired, in the case of a
    loan, investment or interest, other than an interest in real
    property.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Extension

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} The Superintendent may, in the case of any particular
  society, extend any period referred to in subsection (1) for such
  further period or periods, and on such terms and conditions, as the
  Superintendent considers necessary.

::: HistoricalNote
- 1991, c. 47, s. 561
- 1997, c. 15, s. 294
:::

#### [Consumer and Commercial Lending by Societies]{.HTitleText3} {#h-264394 .Subheading}

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Lending limit

**[[562]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-562 .sectionLabel}** A society shall not,
and shall not permit its prescribed subsidiaries to,

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} make or acquire a commercial loan or a loan to a
  natural person, or

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} acquire control of a permitted entity that holds
  commercial loans or loans to natural persons

where the aggregate value of all such loans held by the society and its
prescribed subsidiaries exceeds, or the acquisition or making of the
loan or the acquisition of control of the body corporate would cause the
aggregate value of all such loans held by the society and its prescribed
subsidiaries to exceed, the prescribed percentage of the total assets of
the society.

::: HistoricalNote
- 1991, c. 47, s. 562
- 2001, c. 9, s. 438
:::

#### [Real Property]{.HTitleText3} {#h-264402 .Subheading}

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Limit on total property interest

**[[563]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-563 .sectionLabel}** A society shall not,
and shall not permit its prescribed subsidiaries to,

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} purchase or otherwise acquire an interest in real
  property, or

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} make an improvement to any real property in which the
  society or any of its prescribed subsidiaries has an interest

if the aggregate value of all interests of the society in real property
exceeds, or the acquisition of the interest or the making of the
improvement would cause that aggregate value to exceed, an amount
determined in accordance with the regulations.

::: HistoricalNote
- 1991, c. 47, s. 563
- 2001, c. 9, s. 439
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Regulations

**[[564]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-564 .sectionLabel}** For the purposes of
this Part, the Governor in Council may make regulations

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} defining the interests of a society in real property;

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} determining the method of valuing those interests;
  and

- [(c)]{.lawlabel} respecting the determination of an amount for the
  purpose of each of sections 563, 565 and 566.

::: HistoricalNote
- 1991, c. 47, s. 564
- 2001, c. 9, s. 439
:::

#### [Equities]{.HTitleText3} {#h-264417 .Subheading}

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Limits on equity acquisitions

**[[565]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-565 .sectionLabel}** A society shall not,
and shall not permit its prescribed subsidiaries to,

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} purchase or otherwise acquire any participating
  shares of any body corporate or any ownership interests in any
  unincorporated entity, other than those of a permitted entity in which
  the society has, or by virtue of the acquisition would have, a
  substantial investment, or

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} acquire control of an entity that holds shares or
  ownership interests referred to in paragraph (a),

if the aggregate value of

- [(c)]{.lawlabel} all participating shares, excluding participating
  shares of permitted entities in which the society has a substantial
  investment, and

- [(d)]{.lawlabel} all ownership interests in unincorporated entities,
  other than ownership interests in permitted entities in which the
  society has a substantial investment,

beneficially owned by the society and its prescribed subsidiaries
exceeds, or the purchase or acquisition would cause that aggregate value
to exceed, an amount determined in accordance with the regulations.

::: HistoricalNote
- 1991, c. 47, s. 565
- 1993, c. 34, s. 84(F)
- 1997, c. 15, s. 295
- 2001, c. 9, s. 439
:::

#### [Aggregate Limit]{.HTitleText3} {#h-264428 .Subheading}

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Aggregate limit

**[[566]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-566 .sectionLabel}** A society shall not,
and shall not permit its prescribed subsidiaries to,

- [(a)]{.lawlabel} purchase or otherwise acquire

  - [(i)]{.lawlabel} participating shares of a body corporate, other
    than those of a permitted entity in which the society has, or by
    virtue of the acquisition would have, a substantial investment,

  - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} ownership interests in an unincorporated entity,
    other than ownership interests in a permitted entity in which the
    society has, or by virtue of the acquisition would have, a
    substantial investment, or

  - [(iii)]{.lawlabel} interests in real property, or

- [(b)]{.lawlabel} make an improvement to real property in which the
  society or any of its prescribed subsidiaries has an interest

if the aggregate value of

- [(c)]{.lawlabel} all participating shares and ownership interests
  referred to in subparagraphs (a)(i) and (ii) that are beneficially
  owned by the society and its prescribed subsidiaries, and

- [(d)]{.lawlabel} all interests of the society in real property
  referred to in subparagraph (a)(iii)

exceeds, or the acquisition or the making of the improvement would cause
that aggregate value to exceed, an amount determined in accordance with
the regulations.

::: HistoricalNote
- 1991, c. 47, s. 566
- 1997, c. 15, s. 296
- 2001, c. 9, s. 439
:::

#### [Miscellaneous]{.HTitleText3} {#h-264442 .Subheading}

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Divestment order

- **[[567]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-567 .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} The
  Superintendent may, by order, direct a society to dispose of, within
  such period as the Superintendent considers reasonable, any loan,
  investment or interest made or acquired in contravention of this Part.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Idem

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} Where

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} a society

    - [(i)]{.lawlabel} fails to provide or obtain within a reasonable
      time the undertakings referred to in section 556, or

    - [(ii)]{.lawlabel} is in default of an undertaking referred to in
      section 556 and the default is not remedied within ninety days
      after the day of receipt by the society of a notice from the
      Superintendent of the default, or

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} a body corporate referred to in section 556 is in
    default of an undertaking referred to in section 556 and the default
    is not remedied within ninety days after the day of receipt by the
    society of a notice from the Superintendent of the default,

  the Superintendent may, by order, require the society, within such
  period as the Superintendent considers reasonable, to do all things
  necessary to ensure that the society no longer has a substantial
  investment in the body corporate to which the undertaking relates.

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Deemed temporary investment

**[[568]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-568 .sectionLabel}** If a society controls
or has a substantial investment in an entity as permitted by this Part
and the society becomes aware of a change in the business or affairs of
the entity that, if the change had taken place before the acquisition of
control or of the substantial investment, would have caused the entity
not to be a permitted entity or would have been such that approval for
the acquisition would have been required under subsection 554(5), the
society is deemed to have acquired, on the day the society becomes aware
of the change, a temporary investment in respect of which section 557
applies.

::: HistoricalNote
- 1991, c. 47, s. 568
- 1997, c. 15, s. 297
- 2001, c. 9, s. 440
:::

[Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Asset transactions

- **[[569]{.sectionLabel}]{#s-569 .sectionLabel}** [(1)]{.lawlabel} A
  society shall not, and shall not permit its subsidiaries to, without
  the approval of the Superintendent, acquire assets from a person or
  transfer assets to a person if

  ::: {#264460 .Subsection}
  A + B \> C

  where

  [A]{.dfn}
  :   is the value of the assets;

  [B]{.dfn}
  :   is the total value of all assets that the society and its
      subsidiaries acquired from or transferred to that person in the
      twelve months ending immediately before the acquisition or
      transfer; and

  [C]{.dfn}
  :   is ten per cent of the total value of the assets of the society,
      as shown in the last annual statement of the society prepared
      before the acquisition or transfer.
  :::

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Approval of series of transactions

  [(1.1)]{.lawlabel} The Superintendent may, for the purposes of
  subsection (1), approve a transaction or series of transactions
  relating to the acquisition or transfer of assets that may be entered
  into with a person, or with persons of any class of persons,
  regardless of whether those persons are known at the time of the
  granting of the approval or not.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Exception

  [(2)]{.lawlabel} Subsection (1) does not apply in respect of

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} an asset that is a debt obligation referred to in
    subparagraphs (b)(i) to (v) of the definition "commercial loan" in
    subsection 490(1); or

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} a transaction or series of transactions by a
    society with another financial institution as a result of the
    society's participation in one or more syndicated loans with that
    financial institution.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Exception

  [(3)]{.lawlabel} The approval of the Superintendent under this section
  is not required if

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} the society sells or transfers assets under a
    transaction that is approved by the Minister or the Superintendent
    under subsection 254(2) or (2.01);

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} the society or its subsidiary acquires shares of,
    or ownership interests in, an entity for which the approval of the
    Minister under Part VII or subsection 554(5) is required.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Value of assets

  [(4)]{.lawlabel} For the purposes of "A" in subsection (1), the value
  of the assets is

  - [(a)]{.lawlabel} in the case of assets that are acquired, the
    purchase price of the assets or, if the assets are shares of, or
    ownership interests in, an entity the assets of which will be
    included in the annual statement of the society after the
    acquisition, the fair market value of the assets; and

  - [(b)]{.lawlabel} in the case of assets that are transferred, the
    value of the assets as reported in the last annual statement of the
    society prepared before the transfer or, if the value of the assets
    is not reported in that annual statement, the value of the assets as
    it would be reported in the annual statement of the society if the
    annual statement had been prepared, in accordance with the
    accounting principles referred to in subsection 331(4), immediately
    before the transfer.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Total value of all assets

  [(5)]{.lawlabel} For the purposes of subsection (1), the total value
  of all assets that the society or any of its subsidiaries has acquired
  during the period of twelve months referred to in subsection (1) is
  the purchase price of the assets or, if the assets are shares of, or
  ownership interests in, an entity the assets of which immediately
  after the acquisition were included in the annual statement of the
  society, the fair market value of the assets of the entity at the date
  of the acquisition.

- [Marginal note:]{.wb-invisible}Total value of all assets

  [(6)]{.lawlabel} For the purposes of subsection (1), the total value
  of all assets that the society or any of its subsidiaries has
  transferred during the 12-month period referred to in subsection (1)
  is the total of the value of each of those assets as reported in the
  last annual statement of the society prepared before the transfer of
  the asset or, if the value of any of those assets is not reported in
  that annual statement, as it would be reported in the annual statement
  of the society if the annual statement had been prepared, in
  accordance with the accounting principles referred to in subsection
  331(4), immediately before the transfer of the asset.

::: HistoricalNote
- 1991, c. 47, s. 569
- 2001, c. 9, s. 440
- 2007, c. 6, s. 255
:::
